guide.summary: 着 after a verb says a state is holding: the door is open, she has a coat on, a picture is hanging there. Think of a photo, not a video. 在 + verb is the video (someone is busy doing it); 了 is the moment of change. The same 'held state' idea explains V1着V2 (doing V2 while in state V1), Place + V着 + thing, and commands like 拿着 (keep holding it).

subs.label: V着: a state that is holding
subs.focus: Learner must pick 着 (not 了, 过 or nothing) because the sentence describes how things are at that moment: open, on, worn, held, seated. Force it with 还, 一直, 呢 or a scene description. Classic mistake: 了, which reports the change (门开了 'the door opened'), for a lasting state ('the door is open').

subs.label: 着 (state) vs 在 (action in progress)
subs.focus: Learner must decide between 在 + verb (performing the action) and verb + 着 (result being held). The English cue must settle it: 'is putting on' vs 'is wearing', 'is opening' vs 'is open'. Classic mistake: 在 for every English -ing (门在开). Avoid sentences where 正/在 … V着 … 呢 would also fit.

subs.label: V1着V2: doing V2 in the manner or posture V1
subs.focus: The learner must put 着 on the first verb (the background posture, manner or accompanying action) and leave the main verb bare or with its own 了. Classic mistakes: leaving 着 out (他站说话), putting it on the second verb (他站说着话), or swapping which verb is the background (说着话站).

subs.label: Place + V着 + thing
subs.focus: Learner must build Place + verb + 着 + number-measure + noun for what is hanging, lying, standing, written or parked somewhere. Classic mistakes: 在 + verb (墙上在挂一张画), thing first (一张画挂着墙上), bare verb. Never offer 有 as a distractor in the verb slot: Place + 有 + thing is also correct.

subs.label: 着 in commands: keep it that way
subs.focus: Learner must choose V着 for an order to hold or stay in a state (拿着, 听着, 等着, 坐着, 记着) against the bare verb, 一下 or 了. Context must show the point is keeping the state: 'hold this for me', 'stay seated'. Classic mistakes: 拿了 or 在拿 for 'hold this'; confusing 坐吧 (sit down) with 坐着吧 (stay seated).

subs.label: Negating and asking: 没 … 着, 别 … 着
subs.focus: The learner must negate a 着 state with 没(有), never 不, and use 别 + V着 for 'don't stay like that'. Classic mistake: 门不开着, 他不穿着大衣. Items test the choice of negator; never make the learner choose between 没V着 and 没V, because both are usually acceptable.

subs.label: Where 着 goes
subs.focus: Learner must put 着 directly after the verb and before the object, splitting verb-object words (唱着歌, 聊着天, 看着书), and must not combine 着 with verb + 在 + place. Classic mistakes: 他唱歌着, 她笑了着说, 他躺着在床上.

subs.label: When 着 is not possible
subs.focus: Learner must leave 着 out (∅) or pick 了: with 是, 在, 知道, 认识, 觉得; with instant verbs (到, 去, 死, 忘, 毕业, 结束, 离开); after a result complement (看见, 听懂, 写完); and when a duration or count follows (等了三个小时). Classic mistakes: 我知道着, 他到着北京, 我看见着他, 我等着他一个小时.

rules.rule: Add 着 right after the verb to say the state it produces is still holding. It describes the scene; it does not say when the state began.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 着 (+ Object) (+ 呢)

examples.zh: 她今天穿着一条红裙子。

examples.py: tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī bēi kā fēi
examples.en: He has a cup of coffee in his hand.

rules.note: 还, 一直 and a final 呢 often go with 着. The verbs that take it most are ones of posture, wearing, holding and placing: 坐 站 躺 穿 戴 拿 带 开 关 放 挂 写 停 等.

rules.rule: 了 reports the change; 着 reports the state that follows it. If English says 'is open / is on / is closed', use 着. If it says 'opened / came on / closed', use 了.
rules.pattern: Verb + 了 (it happened)  vs  Verb + 着 (it is like that now)

examples.zh: 窗户开着，所以有点儿冷。
examples.py: chuāng hu kāi zhe suǒ yǐ yǒu diǎn r lěng

examples.py: wǒ dào de shí hou tā zài mén kǒu děng zhe
examples.en: When I arrived, he was waiting at the door.

rules.rule: 在 + verb: someone is busy performing the action. Verb + 着: the result is being held. With 穿, 戴, 开, 关, 挂, 放, 坐 the two mean different things.
rules.pattern: Subject + 在 + Verb + Object (doing it)  vs  Subject + Verb + 着 + Object (state)

rules.note: 着 can also attach to an action that is going on, usually together with 正 or 在 and a final 呢 (外面正下着雨呢). That overlap is real; the drills stay on the cases where only one of the two fits.

rules.rule: To say what someone is doing right now with an ordinary action verb (吃, 写, 打电话, 做饭), use 在. A bare 他吃着饭 sounds unfinished, as if a second action must follow.

examples.py: tā zài dǎ diàn huà bù néng guò lái
examples.en: He is on the phone and can't come over.

examples.py: mā ma zhèng zài zuò fàn ne
examples.en: Mum is cooking right now.

rules.rule: To say how, or in what posture, the main action is done, put 着 on the first verb. The second verb is the main one and carries any 了.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb1 + 着 (+ Object1) + Verb2 (+ Object2)

examples.py: hái zi kū zhe pǎo huí jiā le

rules.note: 一边 … 一边 … also joins two simultaneous actions, but it treats them as equals. V1着V2 makes V1 the background.

rules.rule: To describe what is located somewhere and how it sits there, start with the place, then verb + 着, then the thing with a number and measure word. No 在 before the verb.
rules.pattern: Place + Verb + 着 + number + measure + Noun

rules.note: The place normally comes first without 在. The thing is usually new information, so it takes 一 + measure rather than 这 / 那. Place + 有 + thing is also correct; it just does not say how the thing is positioned.

rules.rule: In a command, verb + 着 means 'get into this state and stay in it': keep holding, keep listening, stay seated, keep it in mind.

examples.py: nǐ zài zhè r děng zhe wǒ mǎ shàng huí lái
examples.en: Wait here, I'll be right back.

rules.note: Only a small set of verbs is used this way: 拿 听 等 坐 站 躺 看 记 带 留 放. 请坐 asks someone to sit down; 坐着 tells someone already sitting not to get up.

rules.rule: A 着 state is negated with 没(有), never 不. To tell someone not to stay in a state, use 别 + verb + 着.
rules.pattern: Subject + 没(有) + Verb + 着   /   别 + Verb + 着 (+ Verb2)

rules.note: In plain denials speakers very often drop 着 after 没: 门没开, 灯没开, 我没带钱. 没 … 着 is kept mainly when the state itself is being denied or contrasted. Both are correct; what is never correct is 不 … 着. Questions use 吗 or 没有: 门开着吗？ 门开着没有？

rules.rule: 着 sticks to the verb, before the object. With verb-object words such as 唱歌, 聊天, 说话, 看书 it goes in the middle. Nothing (了, 过, a complement) comes between the verb and 着.
rules.pattern: Verb + 着 + Object   (唱着歌, 看着书, 带着孩子)

rules.pattern: Subject + Verb (+ 了) + Object   (no 着)

rules.note: This is about everyday speech. A few feeling and thinking verbs do take 着 (爱着, 想着), and written Chinese has 有着; they are not drilled here. Also watch the other reading: in 睡着了 and 着急 the character is zháo, not the particle zhe.

rules.rule: 着 describes, it does not measure. If a duration or a number of times follows the verb, use 了, not 着.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 了 + duration / number of times

examples.en: He stood at the door for ages.

right.py: mén kāi zhe nǐ jìn lái ba
right.en: The door is open, come in.

contrasts.why: English 'is open' is a state, not an action somebody is performing. 在 + 开 would mean the door is in the middle of being opened.

contrasts.wrong: 他今天在穿一件黑衬衫。

right.zh: 他今天穿着一件黑衬衫。
right.py: tā jīn tiān chuān zhe yī jiàn hēi chèn shān
right.en: He is wearing a black shirt today.

contrasts.why: 在穿 is the act of putting the shirt on. 'Is wearing' is the state after that, so it needs 穿着.

right.zh: 她笑着回答了我的问题。
right.py: tā xiào zhe huí dá le wǒ de wèn tí
right.en: She answered my question with a smile.

contrasts.why: Two verbs in a row need 着 on the first to mark it as the manner. 了 belongs to the main verb 回答.

right.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī běn cí diǎn
right.en: There is a dictionary on the table.

contrasts.why: Place + verb + 着 + thing describes what is sitting there. 在放 would need a person who is putting it down right now.

right.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng dì tú
right.en: There is a map hanging on the wall.

contrasts.why: In the 'there is … -ing' pattern the place comes first and the new thing comes after 着. 着 cannot be followed directly by a place.

right.py: chuāng hu méi kāi zhe shì guān zhe de
right.en: The window isn't open; it's closed.

contrasts.why: A 着 state is denied with 没, like other aspect forms. 不 + verb + 着 is not used.

right.py: tā chàng zhe gē zǒu jìn jiào shì
right.en: He walked into the classroom singing.

contrasts.why: 唱歌 is verb + object. 着 attaches to the verb 唱, so the object 歌 comes after it.

right.py: wǒ zhī dào tā de míng zi

contrasts.why: 知道 is already a state with nothing to 'hold', so it never takes 着, even though English 'know' feels ongoing.

right.py: wǒ děng le tā yī gè xiǎo shí le
right.en: I have been waiting for him for an hour.

contrasts.why: A duration measures the action, and 着 cannot be measured. Use verb + 了 + duration.

right.py: tā tǎng zài chuáng shàng kàn shū
right.en: He is lying in bed reading.

contrasts.why: Verb + 在 + place does not take 着. Say 躺在床上, or move the place forward: 在床上躺着.

cheat: Photo or video? A scene you could photograph (open, worn, hanging, seated) takes 着; someone busy doing it takes 在.
'Is open / is on / is wearing' = 着. 'Opened / turned on / put on' = 了.
Two verbs, first one is the posture or manner: 着 goes on the first (站着说, 笑着回答).
Place first, then V着, then 一 + measure + thing: 墙上挂着一张画. No 在 before the verb.
Command to hold or stay: 拿着, 听着, 等着, 坐着.
Negative is 没 (often without 着), or 别 … 着. Never 不 … 着.
着 hugs the verb (唱着歌) and is impossible with 知道, 是, 到, result complements, or a duration.

items.q: 办公室的灯还亮___呢。
items.zh: 办公室的灯还亮着呢。
items.py: bàn gōng shì de dēng hái liàng zhe ne
items.en: The light in the office is still on.
items.why: 还…呢 describes a scene that is still the case, so the lit-up state needs 着. 了 would only report the moment the light came on.

items.q: 诊室的门一直开___，没有人关过。
items.zh: 诊室的门一直开着，没有人关过。
items.py: zhěn shì de mén yī zhí kāi zhe méi yǒu rén guān guò
items.en: The door of the consulting room has been open the whole time; nobody has closed it.
items.why: 一直 says the open state has lasted, so 开着. 开了 reports the change of opening and cannot take 一直.

items.q: 小王一直戴___口罩，因为他感冒了。
items.zh: 小王一直戴着口罩，因为他感冒了。
items.py: xiǎo wáng yī zhí dài zhe kǒu zhào yīn wèi tā gǎn mào le
items.en: Xiao Wang has kept a mask on all along because he has a cold.
items.why: 一直 plus a worn item means the state continues, so 戴着. 戴过 only says he has worn one at some time.

items.q: 她手里还拿___那份病历，站在窗边发呆。
items.zh: 她手里还拿着那份病历，站在窗边发呆。
items.py: tā shǒu lǐ hái ná zhe nà fèn bìng lì zhàn zài chuāng biān fā dāi
items.en: She is still holding the medical record in her hand, standing by the window in a daze.
items.why: 还 and the scene description show she keeps holding it, so 拿着. 拿到 means got hold of, which is a completed result.

items.q: 电脑一直开___，可是没有人用。
items.zh: 电脑一直开着，可是没有人用。
items.py: diàn nǎo yī zhí kāi zhe kě shì méi yǒu rén yòng
items.en: The computer has been left on all along, but nobody is using it.
items.why: 一直 plus a lasting condition needs 着. 开了 would report that it was switched on, which clashes with 一直.

items.q: 已经晚上十点了，经理办公室的灯还亮___，他好像还在加班。
items.zh: 已经晚上十点了，经理办公室的灯还亮着，他好像还在加班。
items.py: yǐ jīng wǎn shàng shí diǎn le jīng lǐ bàn gōng shì de dēng hái liàng zhe tā hǎo xiàng hái zài jiā bān
items.en: It is already ten at night and the light in the manager's office is still on; he seems to be working overtime.
items.why: 还 shows the light is still on, so the held state 亮着. 亮了 would mean it just came on.

items.q: 他发烧了，所以一直躺___，什么也不想做。
items.zh: 他发烧了，所以一直躺着，什么也不想做。
items.py: tā fā shāo le suǒ yǐ yī zhí tǎng zhe shén me yě bù xiǎng zuò
items.en: He has a fever, so he has stayed lying down and doesn't feel like doing anything.
items.why: 一直躺 describes a posture that stays put, so 躺着. 躺了 with 一直 does not work, and 躺在 would need a place right after it.

items.q: 窗户还开___，快去关上。
items.zh: 窗户还开着，快去关上。
items.py: chuāng hu hái kāi zhe kuài qù guān shàng
items.en: The window is still open, go and shut it.
items.why: 还 plus a window that needs shutting describes a standing state, so 开着. 开了 gives no 'still'.

items.q: 他一直皱___眉头，是不是哪里疼？
items.zh: 他一直皱着眉头，是不是哪里疼？
items.py: tā yī zhí zhòu zhe méi tóu shì bù shì nǎ lǐ téng
items.en: He keeps frowning; is something hurting somewhere?
items.why: 一直 pairs with a continuing expression, so 皱着眉头. 皱了 reports a single frown.

items.q: 会议室里很安静，大家都低头坐___。
items.zh: 会议室里很安静，大家都低头坐着。
items.py: huì yì shì lǐ hěn ān jìng dà jiā dōu dī tóu zuò zhe
items.en: The meeting room is quiet; everyone is sitting with their heads down.
items.why: The sentence paints a still scene, so 坐着. 坐了 would tell of the moment they sat down.

items.q: 妈妈___衣服，你等她一下。
items.zh: 妈妈在穿衣服，你等她一下。
items.py: mā ma zài chuān yī fu nǐ děng tā yī xià
items.en: Mum is getting dressed; wait for her a moment.
items.why: 等她一下 shows the action is happening now, so 在穿. 穿着 would say she is already wearing clothes.

items.q: 他___一件白大褂，站在门口。
items.zh: 他穿着一件白大褂，站在门口。
items.py: tā chuān zhe yī jiàn bái dà guà zhàn zài mén kǒu
items.en: He is wearing a white coat, standing at the door.
items.why: Standing at the door is a result state: he already has it on, so 穿着. 在穿 would mean he is busy putting it on.

items.q: 爸爸___门，你先别进去。
items.zh: 爸爸在开门，你先别进去。
items.py: bà ba zài kāi mén nǐ xiān bié jìn qù
items.en: Dad is opening the door; don't go in yet.
items.why: 别进去 shows the opening is still happening, so 在开. 开着 would say the door already stands open.

items.q: 门___，你可以直接进来。
items.zh: 门开着，你可以直接进来。
items.py: mén kāi zhe nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē jìn lái
items.en: The door is open, you can come straight in.
items.why: 'Is open' is a state, so 开着. 在开 means someone is busy opening it, which would make coming straight in impossible.

items.q: 医生___病人的眼睛，请不要说话。
items.zh: 医生在检查病人的眼睛，请不要说话。
items.py: yī shēng zài jiǎn chá bìng rén de yǎn jing qǐng bù yào shuō huà
items.en: The doctor is examining the patient's eyes; please don't talk.
items.why: An ordinary action in progress takes 在. 检查着 sounds unfinished and needs a second action to follow.

items.q: 他今天___一条蓝领带，看起来很精神。
items.zh: 他今天戴着一条蓝领带，看起来很精神。
items.py: tā jīn tiān dài zhe yī tiáo lán lǐng dài kàn qǐ lái hěn jīng shén
items.en: He is wearing a blue tie today and looks very sharp.
items.why: Looking sharp describes how he is dressed, so 戴着. 在戴 means he is putting it on right now.

items.q: 小李___药，你过一会儿再问他吧。
items.zh: 小李在吃药，你过一会儿再问他吧。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ zài chī yào nǐ guò yī huì r zài wèn tā ba
items.en: Xiao Li is taking his medicine; ask him again in a while.
items.why: He is busy doing it now, so 在吃. 吃着药 is not a plain 'is taking medicine' and would need another action after it.

items.q: 办公室的窗户___，所以今天特别冷。
items.zh: 办公室的窗户开着，所以今天特别冷。
items.py: bàn gōng shì de chuāng hu kāi zhe suǒ yǐ jīn tiān tè bié lěng
items.en: The office windows are open, so it's especially cold today.
items.why: The windows are left open, a state that explains the cold, so 开着. 在开 would mean someone is opening them right now.

items.q: 我走进诊室的时候，医生___口罩，所以我没认出他。
items.zh: 我走进诊室的时候，医生戴着口罩，所以我没认出他。
items.py: wǒ zǒu jìn zhěn shì de shí hou yī shēng dài zhe kǒu zhào suǒ yǐ wǒ méi rèn chū tā
items.en: When I walked into the consulting room the doctor was wearing a mask, so I didn't recognize him.
items.why: I failed to recognize him because the mask was already on, which is a state, so 戴着. 在戴 would mean he was in the middle of putting it on.

items.q: 老师站___上课。
items.zh: 老师站着上课。
items.py: lǎo shī zhàn zhe shàng kè
items.en: The teacher teaches standing up.
items.why: 站 is the posture in which 上课 happens, so it takes 着. Without it the two verbs do not link.

items.q: 他躺___看手机，所以眼睛很累。
items.zh: 他躺着看手机，所以眼睛很累。
items.py: tā tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī suǒ yǐ yǎn jing hěn lèi
items.en: He lies down looking at his phone, so his eyes are tired.
items.why: 躺 is the background posture and carries 着; 看手机 is the main action. 在 cannot attach straight after a verb here.

items.q: 我喜欢听___音乐写报告。
items.zh: 我喜欢听着音乐写报告。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan tīng zhe yīn yuè xiě bào gào
items.en: I like writing reports while listening to music.
items.why: 听音乐 is the accompanying action, so 听着. 听了 would be a finished event, which clashes with 喜欢.

items.q: 同事低___头走进办公室，什么也没说。
items.zh: 同事低着头走进办公室，什么也没说。
items.py: tóng shì dī zhe tóu zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì shén me yě méi shuō
items.en: My colleague walked into the office with his head down and said nothing.
items.why: The posture 低头 is held while walking in, so 低着头. 地 is the adverb marker and cannot follow a single verb like 低.

items.q: 孩子咳嗽___说：“我不想吃药。”
items.zh: 孩子咳嗽着说：“我不想吃药。”
items.py: hái zi ké sou zhe shuō wǒ bù xiǎng chī yào
items.en: The child said, coughing, 'I don't want to take medicine.'
items.why: The coughing goes on while speaking, so 咳嗽着说. 地 marks an adverb and does not fit after the verb 咳嗽.

items.q: 他靠___椅子，慢慢地向大家介绍了新计划。
items.zh: 他靠着椅子，慢慢地向大家介绍了新计划。
items.py: tā kào zhe yǐ zi màn màn de xiàng dà jiā jiè shào le xīn jì huà
items.en: Leaning back in his chair, he slowly introduced the new plan to everyone.
items.why: 靠 is his posture during the introduction, so 靠着. 地 is already used for 慢慢地 and cannot join 靠 to its object.

items.q: 护士扶___老人走进诊室，小声告诉医生他最近睡得不好。
items.zh: 护士扶着老人走进诊室，小声告诉医生他最近睡得不好。
items.py: hù shì fú zhe lǎo rén zǒu jìn zhěn shì xiǎo shēng gào sù yī shēng tā zuì jìn shuì de bù hǎo
items.en: The nurse helped the old man into the consulting room and quietly told the doctor he had been sleeping badly lately.
items.why: 扶 is the manner of 走进诊室, so 扶着. 扶过 would only say she had helped him before.

items.q: 桌子上放___一台电脑。
items.zh: 桌子上放着一台电脑。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī tái diàn nǎo
items.en: There is a computer on the desk.
items.why: Place + verb + 着 + thing describes what is sitting somewhere, so 放着. 放在 needs the place after it, not the thing.

items.q: 墙上挂___一张地图。
items.zh: 墙上挂着一张地图。
items.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng dì tú
items.en: There is a map hanging on the wall.
items.why: The place comes first and 着 follows the verb: 墙上挂着一张地图. 挂在 would need the place to follow.

items.q: 医院门口现在还停___两辆救护车。
items.zh: 医院门口现在还停着两辆救护车。
items.py: yī yuàn mén kǒu xiàn zài hái tíng zhe liǎng liàng jiù hù chē
items.en: Two ambulances are still parked at the hospital entrance.
items.why: 现在还 makes it a state that holds, so 停着. 停了 does not combine with 还 and would only report that they stopped.

items.q: 黑板上写___今天会议的时间和地点。
items.zh: 黑板上写着今天会议的时间和地点。
items.py: hēi bǎn shàng xiě zhe jīn tiān huì yì de shí jiān hé dì diǎn
items.en: The time and place of today's meeting are written on the blackboard.
items.why: Place + verb + 着 + thing is the pattern: 写着. 地 and 的 cannot take the verb slot here.

items.q: 办公桌后面坐___一位年轻的医生。
items.zh: 办公桌后面坐着一位年轻的医生。
items.py: bàn gōng zhuō hòu miàn zuò zhe yī wèi nián qīng de yī shēng
items.en: A young doctor is sitting behind the desk.
items.why: The place leads and 坐着 introduces who is sitting there. 坐在 is always followed by a place, not by a person.

items.q: 走廊两边贴___很多关于健康的海报，大家路过时都会看一眼。
items.zh: 走廊两边贴着很多关于健康的海报，大家路过时都会看一眼。
items.py: zǒu láng liǎng biān tiē zhe hěn duō guān yú jiàn kāng de hǎi bào dà jiā lù guò shí dōu huì kàn yī yǎn
items.en: Lots of health posters are stuck up on both sides of the corridor, and everyone takes a look as they pass.
items.why: The corridor is the place and 贴着 describes the posters that are up there. 的 and 地 are particles, not the verb slot.

items.q: 他的办公桌上堆___很多还没处理的文件，旁边还放着一杯凉了的茶。
items.zh: 他的办公桌上堆着很多还没处理的文件，旁边还放着一杯凉了的茶。
items.py: tā de bàn gōng zhuō shàng duī zhe hěn duō hái méi chǔ lǐ de wén jiàn páng biān hái fàng zhe yī bēi liáng le de chá
items.en: Piles of unprocessed documents are stacked on his desk, with a cup of cold tea beside them.
items.why: 堆着 says what is lying there. 堆到 would need a destination, and 堆在 would need a place after it.

items.q: 你拿___这杯水，我去开门。
items.zh: 你拿着这杯水，我去开门。
items.py: nǐ ná zhe zhè bēi shuǐ wǒ qù kāi mén
items.en: Hold this glass of water, I'll go and open the door.
items.why: An order to keep holding something uses verb + 着. 拿了 reports a finished act, and 在 cannot follow the verb.

items.q: 你坐___吧，我自己来。
items.zh: 你坐着吧，我自己来。
items.py: nǐ zuò zhe ba wǒ zì jǐ lái
items.en: Stay seated, I'll do it myself.
items.why: The speaker tells someone already sitting not to get up, which is 坐着吧. 坐了吧 does not exist as a command.

items.q: 你在这儿等___，我马上回来。
items.zh: 你在这儿等着，我马上回来。
items.py: nǐ zài zhè r děng zhe wǒ mǎ shàng huí lái
items.en: Wait here, I'll be right back.
items.why: 等着 means keep waiting until I'm back. 等了 would say that you waited, which is not an order.

items.q: 医生让我躺___，不要动。
items.zh: 医生让我躺着，不要动。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ tǎng zhe bù yào dòng
items.en: The doctor told me to stay lying down and not move.
items.why: The doctor wants the posture held, so 躺着. 躺了 would report that I lay down and gives no instruction to stay.

items.q: 你听___，这个问题非常重要，下午开会的时候一定要说。
items.zh: 你听着，这个问题非常重要，下午开会的时候一定要说。
items.py: nǐ tīng zhe zhè ge wèn tí fēi cháng zhòng yào xià wǔ kāi huì de shí hou yī dìng yào shuō
items.en: Listen, this issue is very important; you must raise it at the afternoon meeting.
items.why: 'Listen up' as a command is 你听着. 听到 means heard it, which is a result rather than an order.

items.q: 这份报告你先带___，明天开会的时候给经理。
items.zh: 这份报告你先带着，明天开会的时候给经理。
items.py: zhè fèn bào gào nǐ xiān dài zhe míng tiān kāi huì de shí hou gěi jīng lǐ
items.en: Keep this report with you for now and give it to the manager at tomorrow's meeting.
items.why: The report is to stay with you until tomorrow, so 带着. 带了 would say you brought it already.

items.q: 这是你的体检单，请你好好记___，下次检查的时候带来。
items.zh: 这是你的体检单，请你好好记着，下次检查的时候带来。
items.py: zhè shì nǐ de tǐ jiǎn dān qǐng nǐ hǎo hǎo jì zhe xià cì jiǎn chá de shí hou dài lái
items.en: This is your check-up form; please keep it in mind and bring it next time.
items.why: 记着 is the order to keep something in mind. 记了 only reports that you noted it down.

items.q: 你先在椅子上坐___，医生马上就来给你检查。
items.zh: 你先在椅子上坐着，医生马上就来给你检查。
items.py: nǐ xiān zài yǐ zi shàng zuò zhe yī shēng mǎ shàng jiù lái gěi nǐ jiǎn chá
items.en: Stay seated in the chair for now; the doctor will be right in to examine you.
items.why: The order is to remain seated until the doctor comes, so 坐着. 坐了 is a past report and cannot be an order.

items.q: 我今天___戴着口罩，所以有点儿感冒。
items.zh: 我今天没戴着口罩，所以有点儿感冒。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān méi dài zhe kǒu zhào suǒ yǐ yǒu diǎn r gǎn mào
items.en: I haven't been wearing a mask today, so I've caught a bit of a cold.
items.why: A 着 state is denied with 没. 不 is not used with 戴着, and 别 is only for commands.

items.q: 办公室的窗户___开着，是关着的。
items.zh: 办公室的窗户没开着，是关着的。
items.py: bàn gōng shì de chuāng hu méi kāi zhe shì guān zhe de
items.en: The office window isn't open; it's closed.
items.why: Denying a 着 state takes 没, never 不. 别 would turn it into an order.

items.q: 他___站着，一直坐在椅子上。
items.zh: 他没站着，一直坐在椅子上。
items.py: tā méi zhàn zhe yī zhí zuò zài yǐ zi shàng
items.en: He wasn't standing; he sat in the chair the whole time.
items.why: Denying a state that held (or did not) uses 没 + verb + 着. 不 + verb + 着 does not exist.

items.q: 你感冒了，___躺着看手机，快睡觉吧。
items.zh: 你感冒了，别躺着看手机，快睡觉吧。
items.py: nǐ gǎn mào le bié tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī kuài shuì jiào ba
items.en: You have a cold; don't lie there looking at your phone, go to sleep.
items.why: Telling someone to stop holding a posture is 别 + verb + 着. 没 and 不 describe facts, not orders.

items.q: 他的电脑___开着，所以我以为他不在办公室。
items.zh: 他的电脑没开着，所以我以为他不在办公室。
items.py: tā de diàn nǎo méi kāi zhe suǒ yǐ wǒ yǐ wéi tā bù zài bàn gōng shì
items.en: His computer wasn't on, so I thought he wasn't in the office.
items.why: A past or present 着 state is denied with 没. 不开着 is not Chinese and 别 would be a command.

items.q: 他___走进办公室，大家都笑了。
items.zh: 他唱着歌走进办公室，大家都笑了。
items.py: tā chàng zhe gē zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì dà jiā dōu xiào le
items.en: He walked into the office singing, and everyone laughed.
items.why: 着 sits right after the verb and before the object: 唱着歌. 着唱歌 and 歌唱着 put 着 in the wrong place.

items.q: 他___椅子上看报告。
items.zh: 他坐在椅子上看报告。
items.py: tā zuò zài yǐ zi shàng kàn bào gào
items.en: He sits in the chair reading a report.
items.why: With a place after the verb the form is 坐在 + place, with no 着. 坐着在 stacks 着 before 在.

items.q: 同事___女儿来公司，大家都很喜欢她。
items.zh: 同事带着女儿来公司，大家都很喜欢她。
items.py: tóng shì dài zhe nǚ ér lái gōng sī dà jiā dōu hěn xǐ huan tā
items.en: A colleague brought her daughter to the company, and everyone likes her.
items.why: 着 attaches right after the verb: 带着女儿. 着带 and 带了着 put it in the wrong place.

items.q: 我知道___你今天不舒服。
items.zh: 我知道你今天不舒服。
items.py: wǒ zhī dào nǐ jīn tiān bù shū fu
items.en: I know you aren't feeling well today.
items.why: 知道 is already a state, so nothing can hold: no 着. Adding 了 or 过 changes it into getting to know or having known.

items.q: 他今天九点到___办公室，一直忙到现在。
items.zh: 他今天九点到了办公室，一直忙到现在。
items.py: tā jīn tiān jiǔ diǎn dào le bàn gōng shì yī zhí máng dào xiàn zài
items.en: He got to the office at nine today and has been busy ever since.
items.why: 到 is an instant arrival, so no 着; 了 marks the completed arrival. 到过 would mean he once visited, which clashes with staying busy since then.

items.q: 我们等___三个小时，医生才来。
items.zh: 我们等了三个小时，医生才来。
items.py: wǒ men děng le sān gè xiǎo shí yī shēng cái lái
items.en: We waited three hours before the doctor came.
items.why: A duration after the verb needs 了, never 着, because 着 cannot be measured.

items.q: 他觉得___这个办法不太好。
items.zh: 他觉得这个办法不太好。
items.py: tā jué de zhè ge bàn fǎ bù tài hǎo
items.en: He thinks this method is not very good.
items.why: 觉得 is a thinking verb with nothing to hold, so no 着 goes after it. 了 would change it into a different meaning.

items.q: 我在医院门口等___半个小时，可是他还没来。
items.zh: 我在医院门口等了半个小时，可是他还没来。
items.py: wǒ zài yī yuàn mén kǒu děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí kě shì tā hái méi lái
items.en: I waited half an hour at the hospital entrance, but he still hasn't come.
items.why: 半个小时 is a measured duration, so 等了半个小时. 等着 cannot be followed by a duration.

items.q: 他已经忘___把药带来了，真麻烦。
items.zh: 他已经忘了把药带来了，真麻烦。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng wàng le bǎ yào dài lái le zhēn má fan
items.en: He has already forgotten to bring the medicine; what a nuisance.
items.why: 忘 is an instant change, so it takes 了 and never 着.

items.q: 他们已经离开___公司，现在在去机场的路上。
items.zh: 他们已经离开了公司，现在在去机场的路上。
items.py: tā men yǐ jīng lí kāi le gōng sī xiàn zài zài qù jī chǎng de lù shàng
items.en: They have already left the company and are now on the way to the airport.
items.why: 离开 is an instant change, so it takes 了. 着 does not fit, and 过 would clash with the present on-the-way situation.

items.zh: 他穿着白大褂。
items.py: tā chuān zhe bái dà guà
items.en: He is wearing a white coat.
items.why: 穿着 keeps the verb and 着 together, followed by the thing worn. 着 cannot stand after 白大褂.

items.zh: 黑板旁边挂着一个时钟。
items.py: hēi bǎn páng biān guà zhe yī gè shí zhōng
items.en: There is a clock hanging beside the blackboard.
items.why: Place first, then verb + 着, then the new thing. 一个时钟 cannot lead the sentence in this pattern.

items.zh: 办公室门口停着一辆白色的车。
items.py: bàn gōng shì mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng bái sè de chē
items.en: A white car is parked at the office entrance.
items.why: Place + verb + 着 + thing. The place comes first and is not marked with 在.

items.zh: 经理站着开会。
items.py: jīng lǐ zhàn zhe kāi huì
items.en: The manager holds the meeting standing up.
items.why: 着 goes on the posture verb 站, which comes first. 开会 is the main verb and stays bare.

items.zh: 他喜欢躺着看手机。
items.py: tā xǐ huan tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī
items.en: He likes to look at his phone lying down.
items.why: 躺着 is the background posture and must precede 看手机. Reversing them would make looking the posture.

items.zh: 你拿着这个文件。
items.py: nǐ ná zhe zhè ge wén jiàn
items.en: Hold this document.
items.why: 拿着 is the command to keep holding. The object may be fronted as a topic, so both orders are right.

items.zh: 你在这儿等着我。
items.py: nǐ zài zhè r děng zhe wǒ
items.en: Wait here for me.
items.why: 等着 is the order to keep waiting. The place phrase can precede or follow 你.

items.zh: 他没戴着口罩。
items.py: tā méi dài zhe kǒu zhào
items.en: He isn't wearing a mask.
items.why: 没 comes before the verb + 着. 不 is never used to deny a 着 state.

items.zh: 别躺着看手机。
items.py: bié tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī
items.en: Don't look at your phone lying down.
items.why: 别 comes first and 着 stays on the first verb 躺. 看手机 follows as the main action.

items.zh: 她带着孩子来上班了。
items.py: tā dài zhe hái zi lái shàng bān le
items.en: She came to work with her child.
items.why: 着 stays glued to 带, before the object 孩子. 了 closes the sentence after 上班.

items.zh: 医生在检查病人。
items.py: yī shēng zài jiǎn chá bìng rén
items.en: The doctor is examining the patient.
items.why: An ordinary action in progress takes 在 before the verb. 着 is not needed.

items.zh: 会议室的桌子上放着三杯咖啡。
items.py: huì yì shì de zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe sān bēi kā fēi
items.en: There are three cups of coffee on the meeting-room table.
items.why: Place first, then verb + 着, then number + measure + noun. 在 does not appear before the verb.

items.zh: 经理办公室的门一直开着。
items.py: jīng lǐ bàn gōng shì de mén yī zhí kāi zhe
items.en: The door to the manager's office has been open all along.
items.why: 一直 sits before the verb, and 着 follows 开. 开着 cannot precede 一直.

items.zh: 病人手里还拿着那张检查单。
items.py: bìng rén shǒu lǐ hái ná zhe nà zhāng jiǎn chá dān
items.en: The patient is still holding that examination form.
items.why: 还 comes before the verb, and 着 follows it directly. The object comes last.

items.zh: 她红着眼睛走出了医生办公室。
items.py: tā hóng zhe yǎn jing zǒu chū le yī shēng bàn gōng shì
items.en: She walked out of the doctor's office with red eyes.
items.why: 红着眼睛 is the state in which she walked out, so it precedes 走出了. 了 stays on the main verb.

items.src_py: tā zài chuān dà yī
items.task: Say he is wearing a coat (a state, not the act).
items.zh: 他穿着大衣。
items.py: tā chuān zhe dà yī
items.en: He is wearing a coat.
items.why: In the source 在穿 means he is putting the coat on. The state of wearing it is 穿着.

items.src_py: tā chuān zhe yī jiàn hēi wài tào
items.task: Say he is putting on a black coat right now.
items.zh: 他在穿一件黑外套。
items.py: tā zài chuān yī jiàn hēi wài tào
items.en: He is putting on a black coat.
items.why: The act in progress needs 在 before the verb, and 着 is dropped.

items.src_py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī bēi kā fēi
items.task: Say how it sits there: use 放.
items.zh: 桌子上放着一杯咖啡。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī bēi kā fēi
items.en: There is a cup of coffee on the table.
items.why: Place + 放着 + thing says that something is placed there. The place stays first.

items.src_py: yǒu yī wèi hù shì zhàn zài mén kǒu
items.task: Start with the place and use 着.
items.zh: 门口站着一位护士。
items.py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī wèi hù shì
items.en: A nurse is standing at the door.
items.why: Place leads, then 站着, then the new person. Put 着 on 站 and drop 在.

items.src: 她笑了，然后回答了我的问题。
items.src_py: tā xiào le rán hòu huí dá le wǒ de wèn tí
items.task: Make the smile the manner of answering.
items.zh: 她笑着回答了我的问题。
items.py: tā xiào zhe huí dá le wǒ de wèn tí
items.en: She answered my question with a smile.
items.why: 笑着 becomes the manner of the main verb 回答, which keeps 了.

items.src_py: hù shì dài zhe shǒu tào
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 护士没戴着手套。
items.py: hù shì méi dài zhe shǒu tào
items.en: The nurse isn't wearing gloves.
items.why: Add 没 before the verb and keep 着. 不 never negates a 着 state.

items.src_py: nǐ ná yī xià zhè bēi shuǐ
items.task: Say 'Hold this cup of water' with 着.
items.zh: 你拿着这杯水。
items.py: nǐ ná zhe zhè bēi shuǐ
items.en: Hold this cup of water.
items.why: 拿着 turns the request into keep holding it. The object may be fronted, so both orders work.

items.src_py: bìng rén zài chuáng shàng tǎng zhe
items.task: Turn it into an order: stay lying down.
items.zh: 你躺着吧。
items.py: nǐ tǎng zhe ba
items.en: Stay lying down.
items.why: 躺着吧 tells the patient to keep the posture. It drops the place and the third person.

items.src_py: tā chàng gē zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì
items.task: Say he walked in singing, using 着.
items.zh: 他唱着歌走进办公室。
items.py: tā chàng zhe gē zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì
items.en: He walked into the office singing.
items.why: 着 attaches to 唱 and splits it from 歌. 走进 stays the main verb.

items.src_py: hù shì zài yī yuàn mén kǒu děng nǐ
items.task: Say the nurse is waiting there with 着 and 在 the place.
items.zh: 护士在医院门口等着你。
items.py: hù shì zài yī yuàn mén kǒu děng zhe nǐ
items.en: The nurse is waiting for you at the hospital entrance.
items.why: On this reading the place stays before the verb and 着 follows 等. Do not put 着 after the place phrase.

items.s: 窗户一直开了，所以屋里很冷。
items.s_py: chuāng hu yì zhí kāi le suǒ yǐ wū lǐ hěn lěng
items.zh: 窗户一直开着，所以屋里很冷。
items.py: chuāng hu yī zhí kāi zhe suǒ yǐ wū lǐ hěn lěng
items.en: The window has been open all along, so it's cold in the room.
items.why: 一直 needs the lasting state 开着. 开了 reports the change of opening and cannot take 一直.

items.s: 医生今天一直忙着，没有时间吃午饭。
items.s_py: yī shēng jīn tiān yì zhí máng zhe méi yǒu shí jiān chī wǔ fàn
items.zh: 医生今天一直忙着，没有时间吃午饭。
items.py: yī shēng jīn tiān yī zhí máng zhe méi yǒu shí jiān chī wǔ fàn
items.en: The doctor has been busy all day and had no time to eat lunch.
items.why: 忙着 is correct: 着 can follow a state verb like 忙, and 一直 helps. The sentence is not wrong because 忙 is not a posture.

items.s: 经理办公室里亮着灯，他可能还没走。
items.s_py: jīng lǐ bàn gōng shì lǐ liàng zhe dēng tā kě néng hái méi zǒu
items.zh: 经理办公室里亮着灯，他可能还没走。
items.py: jīng lǐ bàn gōng shì lǐ liàng zhe dēng tā kě néng hái méi zǒu
items.en: The light is on in the manager's office; he may not have left yet.
items.why: The place comes first and 亮着 is a lit-up state. It looks like it might need 了 but a lasting scene takes 着.

items.s: 你看，门在开，我们可以进去了。
items.s_py: nǐ kān mén zài kāi wǒ men kě yǐ jìn qù le
items.zh: 你看，门开着，我们可以进去了。
items.py: nǐ kàn mén kāi zhe wǒ men kě yǐ jìn qù le
items.en: Look, the door is open, we can go in now.
items.why: 'Is open' is a state, so 开着. 在开 means someone is opening it right now, which would not let us go in.

items.s: 她今天在穿一条红裙子，真漂亮。
items.s_py: tā jīn tiān zài chuān yī tiáo hóng qún zi zhēn piào liàng
items.zh: 她今天穿着一条红裙子，真漂亮。
items.py: tā jīn tiān chuān zhe yī tiáo hóng qún zi zhēn piào liang
items.en: She is wearing a red skirt today; it looks lovely.
items.why: Admiring what she looks like needs the state 穿着. 在穿 is the act of putting it on.

items.s: 他在吃药，请你等一会儿再进去。
items.s_py: tā zài chī yào qǐng nǐ děng yī huì r zài jìn qù
items.zh: 他在吃药，请你等一会儿再进去。
items.py: tā zài chī yào qǐng nǐ děng yī huì r zài jìn qù
items.en: He is taking his medicine; please wait a little before going in.
items.why: An ordinary action in progress takes 在. 吃着药 would sound unfinished here.

items.s: 老板站开会，大家也不敢坐。
items.s_py: lǎo bǎn zhàn kāi huì dà jiā yě bù gǎn zuò
items.zh: 老板站着开会，大家也不敢坐。
items.py: lǎo bǎn zhàn zhe kāi huì dà jiā yě bù gǎn zuò
items.en: The boss holds the meeting standing up, and nobody dares to sit.
items.why: The posture 站 needs 着 to link to the main verb 开会. Without it the two verbs cannot join.

items.s: 护士笑回答了病人的问题。
items.s_py: hù shì xiào huí dá le bìng rén de wèn tí
items.zh: 护士笑着回答了病人的问题。
items.py: hù shì xiào zhe huí dá le bìng rén de wèn tí
items.en: The nurse answered the patient's question with a smile.
items.why: 笑 is the manner and must carry 着. 了 belongs to the main verb 回答.

items.s: 他们坐着聊了一个下午，什么事也没做。
items.s_py: tā men zuò zhe liáo le yí gè xià wǔ shén me shì yě méi zuò
items.zh: 他们坐着聊了一个下午，什么事也没做。
items.py: tā men zuò zhe liáo le yī gè xià wǔ shén me shì yě méi zuò
items.en: They sat and chatted all afternoon without doing anything.
items.why: 着 is on the posture verb 坐 and 了 plus the duration is on the main verb 聊. Both are in the right place.

items.s: 桌子上在放着一份报告。
items.s_py: zhuō zi shàng zài fàng zhe yī fèn bào gào
items.zh: 桌子上放着一份报告。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī fèn bào gào
items.en: There is a report lying on the table.
items.why: Place + 放着 + thing needs no 在 before the verb. 在放着 is not used.

items.s: 走廊里坐着很多等医生的病人。
items.s_py: zǒu láng lǐ zuò zhe hěn duō děng yī shēng de bìng rén
items.zh: 走廊里坐着很多等医生的病人。
items.py: zǒu láng lǐ zuò zhe hěn duō děng yī shēng de bìng rén
items.en: Many patients waiting for the doctor are sitting in the corridor.
items.why: This is the existential pattern: place, then 坐着, then the people, with a long modifier before the noun.

items.s: 你等了，我马上回来。
items.s_py: nǐ děng le wǒ mǎ shàng huí lái
items.zh: 你等着，我马上回来。
items.py: nǐ děng zhe wǒ mǎ shàng huí lái
items.en: Wait, I'll be right back.
items.why: An order to keep waiting uses 等着. 了 reports a finished act and cannot make a command.

items.s: 你先坐着，医生马上就来。
items.s_py: nǐ xiān zuò zhe yī shēng mǎ shàng jiù lái
items.zh: 你先坐着，医生马上就来。
items.py: nǐ xiān zuò zhe yī shēng mǎ shàng jiù lái
items.en: Stay seated for now, the doctor will be right here.
items.why: 坐着 is the usual way to tell someone to stay seated.

items.s: 他不戴着口罩，所以被医生说了。
items.s_py: tā bù dài zhe kǒu zhào suǒ yǐ bèi yī shēng shuō le
items.zh: 他没戴着口罩，所以被医生说了。
items.py: tā méi dài zhe kǒu zhào suǒ yǐ bèi yī shēng shuō le
items.en: He wasn't wearing a mask, so the doctor told him off.
items.why: A 着 state is denied with 没. 不戴着 is not used.

items.s: 办公室的灯没开着，里面没人。
items.s_py: bàn gōng shì de dēng méi kāi zhe lǐ miàn méi rén
items.zh: 办公室的灯没开着，里面没人。
items.py: bàn gōng shì de dēng méi kāi zhe lǐ miàn méi rén
items.en: The light in the office isn't on; there's nobody inside.
items.why: 没 + verb + 着 is the correct way to deny a 着 state.

items.s: 她带了着孩子去医院。
items.s_py: tā dài le zhe hái zi qù yī yuàn
items.zh: 她带着孩子去医院。
items.py: tā dài zhe hái zi qù yī yuàn
items.en: She took her child to the hospital.
items.why: 着 must follow the verb directly, so nothing like 了 can come between 带 and 着.

items.s: 他知道着你的电话号码。
items.s_py: tā zhī dào zhe nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ
items.zh: 他知道你的电话号码。
items.py: tā zhī dào nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ
items.en: He knows your phone number.
items.why: 知道 never takes 着, even though English 'know' feels ongoing.

items.s: 病人在床上躺着三天了。
items.s_py: bìng rén zài chuáng shàng tǎng zhe sān tiān le
items.zh: 病人在床上躺了三天了。
items.py: bìng rén zài chuáng shàng tǎng le sān tiān le
items.en: The patient has been lying in bed for three days.
items.why: A duration after the verb needs 了, never 着.

items.s: 他睡着了，请你小声一点儿。
items.s_py: tā shuì zháo le qǐng nǐ xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r
items.zh: 他睡着了，请你小声一点儿。
items.py: tā shuì zháo le qǐng nǐ xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r
items.en: He has fallen asleep, so please keep your voice down.
items.why: 睡着 here is shuì zháo, a result complement meaning 'fall asleep', not the particle 着. 了 follows it.

items.s: 他到着办公室了。
items.s_py: tā dào zhe bàn gōng shì le
items.zh: 他到办公室了。
items.py: tā dào bàn gōng shì le
items.en: He has arrived at the office.
items.why: 到 is an instant arrival with nothing to hold, so it never takes 着.

items.q: 商店的门还___，你快进去吧。
items.zh: 商店的门还开着，你快进去吧。
items.py: shāng diàn de mén hái kāi zhe nǐ kuài jìn qù ba
items.en: The shop door is still open, so go in quickly.
items.why: 还 says the door is still in the open state, and 着 reports a state. 开了 only reports that it opened and clashes with 还; 在开 would mean it is in the middle of opening.

items.q: 他手里一直拿___一张购物卡。
items.zh: 他手里一直拿着一张购物卡。
items.py: tā shǒu lǐ yī zhí ná zhe yī zhāng gòu wù kǎ
items.en: He has been holding a shopping card in his hand the whole time.
items.why: 一直 describes a held state, so the verb takes 着. 拿了 reports one act of taking, and 拿过 means he has held one before; neither can be stretched by 一直.

items.q: 她从早上到现在一直戴___那条新项链。
items.zh: 她从早上到现在一直戴着那条新项链。
items.py: tā cóng zǎo shang dào xiàn zài yī zhí dài zhe nà tiáo xīn xiàng liàn
items.en: She has been wearing that new necklace all day, from morning until now.
items.why: 从早上到现在一直 describes one unbroken state of wearing, which is 戴着. 戴过 is 'has worn it before' and 戴了 reports putting it on; neither fits an unbroken stretch.

items.q: 篮球场的灯还___呢，他们还在练球。
items.zh: 篮球场的灯还亮着呢，他们还在练球。
items.py: lán qiú chǎng de dēng hái liàng zhe ne tā men hái zài liàn qiú
items.en: The lights at the basketball court are still on; they are still practising.
items.why: 还 … 呢 describes lights that are on at this moment, so 亮着. 亮了 only says they came on, and 亮过 says they were on at some earlier time.

items.q: 跑步机一直开___，电费特别高。
items.zh: 跑步机一直开着，电费特别高。
items.py: pǎo bù jī yī zhí kāi zhe diàn fèi tè bié gāo
items.en: The treadmill has been left running all the time, so the electricity bill is very high.
items.why: A machine that stays switched on is a continuing state: 开着. 一直 rules out 开了, which marks one change of state, and 开过 would mean it was on once in the past.

items.q: 比赛早就结束了，他还穿___球衣呢。
items.zh: 比赛早就结束了，他还穿着球衣呢。
items.py: bǐ sài zǎo jiù jié shù le tā hái chuān zhe qiú yī ne
items.en: The match ended long ago and he is still wearing his jersey.
items.why: 'Still wearing' is a state after the putting-on, so 穿着. 在穿 would mean he is in the act of putting it on, which does not fit a match that ended long ago.

items.q: 虽然商场已经关门了，可是后门还___，我们进去看看吧。
items.zh: 虽然商场已经关门了，可是后门还开着，我们进去看看吧。
items.py: suī rán shāng chǎng yǐ jīng guān mén le kě shì hòu mén hái kāi zhe wǒ men jìn qù kàn kan ba
items.en: Although the mall has already closed, the back door is still open, so let's go in and look.
items.why: 可是 … 还 points to a door that remains open now: 开着. 开了 would say the door opened, and 开过 would say it has been open at some time before.

items.q: 妈妈___试鞋，你先别催她。
items.zh: 妈妈在试鞋，你先别催她。
items.py: mā ma zài shì xié nǐ xiān bié cuī tā
items.en: Mom is trying on shoes, so don't rush her.
items.why: An ordinary action being performed right now takes 在. 试着 would read as 'try to', and 试了 is finished, which does not fit 别催她.

items.q: 小王穿___一件红球衣，很好认。
items.zh: 小王穿着一件红球衣，很好认。
items.py: xiǎo wáng chuān zhe yī jiàn hóng qiú yī hěn hǎo rèn
items.en: Xiao Wang is wearing a red jersey, so he is easy to spot.
items.why: 'Is wearing' is the state after putting on, so 穿着. 穿在 cannot take the object 一件红球衣 in this way, and 在穿 would mean he is putting it on.

items.q: 店员___开门，你再等一分钟。
items.zh: 店员在开门，你再等一分钟。
items.py: diàn yuán zài kāi mén nǐ zài děng yī fēn zhōng
items.en: The clerk is opening up the shop, so wait one more minute.
items.why: The clerk is still performing the action of opening up, so 在开门. 着 cannot sit on 店员 + 开门 like this; 开着门 would describe a door already standing open, which would make waiting pointless.

items.q: 窗户___，你把它关上吧。
items.zh: 窗户开着，你把它关上吧。
items.py: chuāng hu kāi zhe nǐ bǎ tā guān shàng ba
items.en: The window is open, so close it.
items.why: A window that is open is a state: 开着. 在开 would mean the window is moving open at this moment, which no one would ask you to close.

items.q: 他___外套，你等他一下，马上就好。
items.zh: 他在穿外套，你等他一下，马上就好。
items.py: tā zài chuān wài tào nǐ děng tā yī xià mǎ shàng jiù hǎo
items.en: He is putting on his coat, so wait for him a moment; he'll be ready soon.
items.why: 'Is putting on' is the action in progress, so 在穿. 穿着 would say the coat is already on him, and then there would be nothing to wait for.

items.q: 我发现体育馆的门一直___，所以好多人随便进出。
items.zh: 我发现体育馆的门一直开着，所以好多人随便进出。
items.py: wǒ fā xiàn tǐ yù guǎn de mén yī zhí kāi zhe suǒ yǐ hǎo duō rén suí biàn jìn chū
items.en: I found that the gym door had been open all along, so lots of people came and went as they pleased.
items.why: The door stays in the open state the whole time, so 开着. 一直在开 would mean it keeps opening, and 开了 cannot be stretched by 一直.

items.q: 小李___一件黑色的运动服，我一眼就认出他了。
items.zh: 小李穿着一件黑色的运动服，我一眼就认出他了。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ chuān zhe yī jiàn hēi sè de yùn dòng fú wǒ yī yǎn jiù rèn chū tā le
items.en: Xiao Li was wearing a black tracksuit, and I recognised him at a glance.
items.why: Recognising him by what he wore needs the state 穿着. 在穿 would mean he was busy putting it on, which is not how you spot someone at a glance.

items.q: 他___打电话，不能和我们去买东西。
items.zh: 他在打电话，不能和我们去买东西。
items.py: tā zài dǎ diàn huà bù néng hé wǒ men qù mǎi dōng xi
items.en: He is on the phone and can't go shopping with us.
items.why: An ordinary action in progress takes 在. A bare 他打着电话 sounds unfinished, as if a second action must follow.

items.q: 老板娘笑___收下了我的钱。
items.zh: 老板娘笑着收下了我的钱。
items.py: lǎo bǎn niáng xiào zhe shōu xià le wǒ de qián
items.en: The shopkeeper took my money with a smile.
items.why: The smile is the manner of the main verb 收下, so 着 goes on the first verb 笑. 笑了 would end the smiling before the next action and does not join the two verbs this way.

items.q: 他站___吃冰淇淋。
items.zh: 他站着吃冰淇淋。
items.py: tā zhàn zhe chī bīng qí lín
items.en: He eats his ice cream standing up.
items.why: 站 is the posture while eating, so it takes 着 and 吃 stays bare. 站了 or 站在 cannot be followed directly by another verb in this way.

items.q: 弟弟每天骑___自行车去公园打球。
items.zh: 弟弟每天骑着自行车去公园打球。
items.py: dì di měi tiān qí zhe zì xíng chē qù gōng yuán dǎ qiú
items.en: My younger brother rides his bike to the park to play ball every day.
items.why: Riding is the way he travels while going to play, so 骑着 marks the manner. 每天 is a habit, so 骑了 (a completed act) and 骑过 (an experience) both fail.

items.q: 她哭___跑出了商店，钱包也忘在柜台上了。
items.zh: 她哭着跑出了商店，钱包也忘在柜台上了。
items.py: tā kū zhe pǎo chū le shāng diàn qián bāo yě wàng zài guì tái shàng le
items.en: She ran out of the shop crying and even left her wallet on the counter.
items.why: 哭 describes how she ran out, so it takes 着 and the main verb 跑出 carries the 了. 哭了 or 哭过 placed straight before 跑出 does not link the two actions.

items.q: 他靠___墙看球赛，一动也不动。
items.zh: 他靠着墙看球赛，一动也不动。
items.py: tā kào zhe qiáng kàn qiú sài yī dòng yě bù dòng
items.en: He leaned against the wall watching the match, without moving at all.
items.why: 靠 gives the posture in which he watches, so 靠着墙看球赛. 靠了墙 and 靠过墙 do not fit with a second verb that continues alongside.

items.q: 老人们坐___下棋，一坐就是一下午。
items.zh: 老人们坐着下棋，一坐就是一下午。
items.py: lǎo rén men zuò zhe xià qí yī zuò jiù shì yī xià wǔ
items.en: The old men sit playing chess, and once they sit down it lasts the whole afternoon.
items.why: 坐 is the background posture of 下棋, so 坐着下棋. 坐了 or 坐过 followed directly by 下棋 does not describe a posture held while playing.

items.q: 弟弟光___脚在球场上跑来跑去。
items.zh: 弟弟光着脚在球场上跑来跑去。
items.py: dì di guāng zhe jiǎo zài qiú chǎng shàng pǎo lái pǎo qù
items.en: My younger brother ran around the pitch barefoot.
items.why: 光着脚 is the held state he is in while running. 光了脚 or 光过脚 would not describe a condition continuing during the running.

items.q: 孩子抱___篮球睡着了，怎么叫也叫不醒。
items.zh: 孩子抱着篮球睡着了，怎么叫也叫不醒。
items.py: hái zi bào zhe lán qiú shuì zháo le zěn me jiào yě jiào bù xǐng
items.en: The child fell asleep hugging a basketball and could not be woken however hard we called.
items.why: 抱 is the position held while falling asleep, so 抱着篮球睡着了; the main verb takes 了. 抱过篮球 just says he has hugged one before.

items.q: 购物车里___几瓶水。
items.zh: 购物车里放着几瓶水。
items.py: gòu wù chē lǐ fàng zhe jǐ píng shuǐ
items.en: There are a few bottles of water in the shopping cart.
items.why: Place + 放着 + quantity + noun describes what is sitting there. 在放 needs someone who is putting things in right now, and 放在 must be followed by a place, not a quantity.

items.q: 门上___一张通知，说商店今天休息。
items.zh: 门上贴着一张通知，说商店今天休息。
items.py: mén shàng tiē zhe yī zhāng tōng zhī shuō shāng diàn jīn tiān xiū xi
items.en: A notice is stuck on the door saying the shop is closed today.
items.why: Place first, then 贴着, then 一张 + noun. 在贴 would need a person sticking it up right now, and 贴在 cannot be followed by 一张通知.

items.q: 商店门口___很多自行车。
items.zh: 商店门口停着很多自行车。
items.py: shāng diàn mén kǒu tíng zhe hěn duō zì xíng chē
items.en: Lots of bicycles are parked at the shop entrance.
items.why: The entrance is the place and the bikes are what sits there, so 停着 + noun. 在停 would be bikes in the act of pulling in, and 停在 needs a place after it, not a noun.

items.q: 看台上___很多球迷，都在大声喊。
items.zh: 看台上坐着很多球迷，都在大声喊。
items.py: kàn tái shàng zuò zhe hěn duō qiú mí dōu zài dà shēng hǎn
items.en: Lots of fans are sitting in the stands, all shouting loudly.
items.why: Place + 坐着 + many fans describes who is sitting there. 坐在 would need a place after it, and 在坐 would mean fans are in the middle of sitting down.

items.q: 海报上___“周末大减价”五个字。
items.zh: 海报上写着“周末大减价”五个字。
items.py: hǎi bào shàng xiě zhe zhōu mò dà jiǎn jià wǔ gè zì
items.en: The five characters 'weekend big sale' are written on the poster.
items.why: Writing that is displayed on a surface is Place + 写着 + text. 在写 would mean someone is writing it now, and 写在 would need a place to follow it.

items.q: 体育馆的墙上___一块大屏幕，上面正播着比赛。
items.zh: 体育馆的墙上挂着一块大屏幕，上面正播着比赛。
items.py: tǐ yù guǎn de qiáng shàng guà zhe yī kuài dà píng mù shàng miàn zhèng bō zhe bǐ sài
items.en: A big screen hangs on the wall of the stadium, showing a match.
items.why: Place + 挂着 + 一块 + noun says what is hanging there. 在挂 means someone is hanging it now, and 挂在 would need a place, not 一块大屏幕, after it.

items.q: 钱包里还___两百块钱，够买这双球鞋了。
items.zh: 钱包里还放着两百块钱，够买这双球鞋了。
items.py: qián bāo lǐ hái fàng zhe liǎng bǎi kuài qián gòu mǎi zhè shuāng qiú xié le
items.en: There are still two hundred yuan in the wallet, enough for these shoes.
items.why: Place + 放着 + amount describes what is sitting in the wallet. 在放 would be someone putting money in right now, and 放在 cannot take an amount of money after it.

items.q: 那家运动用品店的橱窗里___好几双新球鞋，价格都不便宜。
items.zh: 那家运动用品店的橱窗里摆着好几双新球鞋，价格都不便宜。
items.py: nà jiā yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn de chú chuāng lǐ bǎi zhe hǎo jǐ shuāng xīn qiú xié jià gé dōu bù pián yi
items.en: Several pairs of new shoes are displayed in the window of that sports shop, and none of them is cheap.
items.why: The window is the place and the shoes are what is displayed there: 摆着 + noun. 在摆 would mean a person is arranging them now; 摆在 needs a place after it.

items.q: 你___这个袋子，我去付钱。
items.zh: 你拿着这个袋子，我去付钱。
items.py: nǐ ná zhe zhè ge dài zi wǒ qù fù qián
items.en: Hold this bag while I go and pay.
items.why: A command to keep holding something while another thing happens is 拿着. 拿了 reports a completed taking and 在拿 describes what he is doing, neither of which is an order to keep holding.

items.q: 你在这儿___，我去买票。
items.zh: 你在这儿等着，我去买票。
items.py: nǐ zài zhè r děng zhe wǒ qù mǎi piào
items.en: Wait here while I go and buy tickets.
items.why: 'Stay here and wait' is a command to hold a state: 等着. 等了 and 等过 report something already past, so they cannot make a request for the future.

items.q: 比赛进行的时候，请大家___，不要站起来。
items.zh: 比赛进行的时候，请大家坐着，不要站起来。
items.py: bǐ sài jìn xíng de shí hou qǐng dà jiā zuò zhe bù yào zhàn qǐ lái
items.en: While the match is on, please stay seated and do not stand up.
items.why: The point is to remain in the seated state, so 坐着. 坐吧 means 'sit down' and 坐了 reports a completed action, so neither says 'stay seated'.

items.q: 这张发票你先___，退货的时候要用。
items.zh: 这张发票你先留着，退货的时候要用。
items.py: zhè zhāng fā piào nǐ xiān liú zhe tuì huò de shí hou yào yòng
items.en: Hang on to this receipt for now, as you'll need it when you return the goods.
items.why: 'Keep it for later' is 留着. 留了 and 留过 describe things that already happened and do not instruct him to keep the receipt.

items.q: 你们___，下周的比赛很重要。
items.zh: 你们听着，下周的比赛很重要。
items.py: nǐ men tīng zhe xià zhōu de bǐ sài hěn zhòng yào
items.en: Listen up, next week's match is important.
items.why: An order to pay attention is 听着, a state to enter and keep. 听了 and 听过 describe what has been done, so a coach could not use them to open a speech.

items.q: 你累了就___休息吧，不用起来帮忙。
items.zh: 你累了就坐着休息吧，不用起来帮忙。
items.py: nǐ lèi le jiù zuò zhe xiū xi ba bù yòng qǐ lái bāng máng
items.en: If you're tired, just stay seated and rest; there's no need to get up and help.
items.why: 不用起来 shows he is already seated, so the advice is to stay that way: 坐着. 坐了 and 在坐 do not give a suggestion to remain seated.

items.q: 窗户___开着，是关着的。
items.zh: 窗户没开着，是关着的。
items.py: chuāng hu méi kāi zhe shì guān zhe de
items.en: The window isn't open; it is closed.
items.why: A 着 state is denied with 没, not 不. 不开着 does not exist as a way of saying a state does not hold.

items.q: 他今天___戴着眼镜，我差点没认出来。
items.zh: 他今天没戴着眼镜，我差点没认出来。
items.py: tā jīn tiān méi dài zhe yǎn jìng wǒ chà diǎn méi rèn chū lái
items.en: He wasn't wearing glasses today, and I almost didn't recognise him.
items.why: Denying a state that holds in a particular situation uses 没 + 戴着. 不戴着 is not a pattern; 不 would be for a habit or a refusal and does not combine with 着.

items.q: 你___坐着了，起来和我们一起打球吧。
items.zh: 你别坐着了，起来和我们一起打球吧。
items.py: nǐ bié zuò zhe le qǐ lái hé wǒ men yī qǐ dǎ qiú ba
items.en: Stop sitting there and come play ball with us.
items.why: An instruction not to keep a state is 别 + verb + 着. 没坐着了 is not a command and is ungrammatical because 没 reports facts, not orders.

items.q: 球场上的灯___亮着，我们看不清球。
items.zh: 球场上的灯没亮着，我们看不清球。
items.py: qiú chǎng shàng de dēng méi liàng zhe wǒ men kàn bù qīng qiú
items.en: The lights on the pitch aren't on, so we can't see the ball clearly.
items.why: The lights were not in the on state, so it is 没 + 亮着. 不亮着 is never used to deny a 着 state.

items.q: 商店的门今天早上___锁着，我一推就开了。
items.zh: 商店的门今天早上没锁着，我一推就开了。
items.py: shāng diàn de mén jīn tiān zǎo shang méi suǒ zhe wǒ yī tuī jiù kāi le
items.en: The shop door wasn't locked this morning; it opened as soon as I pushed.
items.why: The state 'locked' did not hold on one particular morning, so 没 + 锁着. 不锁着 is not used to deny a 着 state.

items.q: 她手里___拿着钱包，原来钱包忘在家里了。
items.zh: 她手里没拿着钱包，原来钱包忘在家里了。
items.py: tā shǒu lǐ méi ná zhe qián bāo yuán lái qián bāo wàng zài jiā lǐ le
items.en: She wasn't holding her wallet; it turns out she had left it at home.
items.why: The state of holding the wallet did not exist, so 没 + 拿着. 不拿着 cannot negate 拿着.

items.q: 爷爷___在沙发上看球赛。
items.zh: 爷爷躺在沙发上看球赛。
items.py: yé ye tǎng zài shā fā shàng kàn qiú sài
items.en: Grandpa is lying on the sofa watching the match.
items.why: With verb + 在 + place, 着 does not appear: 躺在沙发上. 躺着在 is ungrammatical, and 躺了在 puts 了 where the verb takes 在.

items.q: 爷爷在沙发上___看球赛。
items.zh: 爷爷在沙发上躺着看球赛。
items.py: yé ye zài shā fā shàng tǎng zhe kàn qiú sài
items.en: Grandpa is lying on the sofa watching the match.
items.why: When the place comes first as 在沙发上, the verb needs 着 to show the lying state, then the next verb: 躺着看球赛. A bare 躺 or 躺了 followed by 看 does not make the posture the background.

items.q: 小王喜欢___歌做作业。
items.zh: 小王喜欢唱着歌做作业。
items.py: xiǎo wáng xǐ huan chàng zhe gē zuò zuò yè
items.en: Xiao Wang likes to sing while doing his homework.
items.why: 着 goes inside the verb-object word, between 唱 and 歌: 唱着歌. 唱了 and 唱过 report completed or past singing and do not make it a background activity.

items.q: 奶奶一直在商店门口坐___，等孙子买完球鞋。
items.zh: 奶奶一直在商店门口坐着，等孙子买完球鞋。
items.py: nǎi nai yī zhí zài shāng diàn mén kǒu zuò zhe děng sūn zi mǎi wán qiú xié
items.en: Grandma has been sitting at the shop door waiting for her grandson to finish buying sneakers.
items.why: 一直 describes a held posture, and with 在 + place first the verb ends in 着: 在门口坐着. 坐了 would just report that she sat down.

items.q: 他们边喝___茶边聊最近的球赛。
items.zh: 他们边喝着茶边聊最近的球赛。
items.py: tā men biān hē zhe chá biān liáo zuì jìn de qiú sài
items.en: They chatted about recent matches while drinking tea.
items.why: 着 attaches to the verb before its object: 喝着茶. 边喝了茶 and 边喝过茶 are not used because 边 … 边 needs two actions happening together.

items.q: 我不知道___这家店几点关门。
items.zh: 我不知道这家店几点关门。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào zhè jiā diàn jǐ diǎn guān mén
items.en: I don't know what time this shop closes.
items.why: 知道 is a mental state and never takes 着, so nothing goes in the blank.

items.q: 我们在商店门口等___三个小时，他才来。
items.zh: 我们在商店门口等了三个小时，他才来。
items.py: wǒ men zài shāng diàn mén kǒu děng le sān gè xiǎo shí tā cái lái
items.en: We waited at the shop door for three hours before he came.
items.why: A duration (三个小时) measures the action, so it takes 了. 着 describes a state and cannot be followed by a length of time.

items.q: 教练说的话我都听懂___，不用再说了。
items.zh: 教练说的话我都听懂了，不用再说了。
items.py: jiào liàn shuō de huà wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le bù yòng zài shuō le
items.en: I understood everything the coach said, so there's no need to say it again.
items.why: 听懂 already has a result complement and reports a completed outcome, so 了. 着 cannot be added to a verb with a result complement.

items.q: 我觉得___这双鞋有点儿贵，你觉得呢？
items.zh: 我觉得这双鞋有点儿贵，你觉得呢？
items.py: wǒ jué de zhè shuāng xié yǒu diǎn r guì nǐ jué de ne
items.en: I think these shoes are a bit expensive. What do you think?
items.why: 觉得 is an opinion verb and takes no 着, so the blank stays empty.

items.q: 我哥哥现在在___超市，不在家。
items.zh: 我哥哥现在在超市，不在家。
items.py: wǒ gē ge xiàn zài zài chāo shì bù zài jiā
items.en: My older brother is at the supermarket now, not at home.
items.why: 在 as 'be at' is a location verb with nothing to hold, so it never takes 着.

items.q: 他去年大学毕业___，现在在体育用品店工作。
items.zh: 他去年大学毕业了，现在在体育用品店工作。
items.py: tā qù nián dà xué bì yè le xiàn zài zài tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn gōng zuò
items.en: He graduated from university last year and now works in a sports shop.
items.why: 毕业 is an instant event with no continuing state, so it takes 了 and never 着.

items.q: 比赛七点开始，我们六点半就到___体育场了。
items.zh: 比赛七点开始，我们六点半就到了体育场了。
items.py: bǐ sài qī diǎn kāi shǐ wǒ men liù diǎn bàn jiù dào le tǐ yù chǎng le
items.en: The match starts at seven, and we had already arrived at the stadium by half past six.
items.why: 到 is an instant arrival with no state to hold, so 到了. 到着 does not exist.

items.zh: 柜台上摆着几双新球鞋。
items.py: guì tái shàng bǎi zhe jǐ shuāng xīn qiú xié
items.en: Several pairs of new sneakers are displayed on the counter.
items.why: The place comes first, then the verb with 着, then the quantity and the thing. The thing cannot come before the place.

items.zh: 老板摇着头说：“不能再便宜了。”。
items.py: lǎo bǎn yáo zhe tóu shuō bù néng zài pián yi le
items.en: The boss said, shaking his head, "I can't go any cheaper."
items.why: 摇着头 is the manner and goes before the main verb 说. 说 cannot take 着 here because it is the main action.

items.zh: 球迷们站着看完了整场比赛。
items.py: qiú mí men zhàn zhe kàn wán le zhěng chǎng bǐ sài
items.en: The fans watched the whole match standing up.
items.why: 站着 is the background posture and comes first; 看完了 is the main verb with its result and 了.

items.zh: 他穿着一件旧球衣。
items.py: tā chuān zhe yī jiàn jiù qiú yī
items.en: He is wearing an old jersey.
items.why: 着 comes right after the verb, before the object phrase.

items.zh: 桌上的灯还亮着呢。
items.py: zhuō shàng de dēng hái liàng zhe ne
items.en: The lamp on the desk is still on.
items.why: 还 sits before the verb phrase with 着, and 呢 closes the sentence.

items.zh: 你先拿着这些票。
items.py: nǐ xiān ná zhe zhè xiē piào
items.en: Hold on to these tickets for now.
items.why: 先 goes before the verb, and 着 follows 拿 to say keep holding.

items.zh: 你要记着带球鞋。
items.py: nǐ yào jì zhe dài qiú xié
items.en: Remember to bring your sneakers.
items.why: 记着 keeps the thing in mind and comes before the action to remember. 要 goes before 记着.

items.zh: 他今天没穿着外套。
items.py: tā jīn tiān méi chuān zhe wài tào
items.en: He isn't wearing a coat today.
items.why: 没 goes directly before 穿着. 不 cannot negate a verb with 着.

items.zh: 别戴着帽子进来。
items.py: bié dài zhe mào zi jìn lái
items.en: Don't come in wearing a hat.
items.why: 别 + V着 + object + next verb: wearing is the background state while entering.

items.zh: 小王在球场边站着。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zài qiú chǎng biān zhàn zhe
items.en: Xiao Wang is standing at the edge of the pitch.
items.why: With a place before the verb, the pattern is 在 + place + verb + 着. The place cannot follow 站着.

items.zh: 她唱着歌走出了商店。
items.py: tā chàng zhe gē zǒu chū le shāng diàn
items.en: She walked out of the shop singing.
items.why: 着 goes inside 唱歌, between 唱 and 歌. 唱歌着 is wrong.

items.zh: 孩子们在球场上踢球。
items.py: hái zi men zài qiú chǎng shàng tī qiú
items.en: The kids are playing football on the pitch.
items.why: An ordinary action in progress takes 在 before the verb, with the place phrase between 在 and the verb.

items.zh: 超市门口排着一条很长的队。
items.py: chāo shì mén kǒu pái zhe yī tiáo hěn cháng de duì
items.en: A very long line has formed at the supermarket entrance.
items.why: Place first, then 排着, then 一条 and the described noun. 在 cannot come before the verb.

items.zh: 价格牌上写着“特价”两个字。
items.py: jià gé pái shàng xiě zhe tè jià liǎng gè zì
items.en: The two characters 'special offer' are written on the price tag.
items.why: Place + 写着 + the text. The place has no 在, and 着 comes straight after 写.

items.src_py: shāng diàn de mén kāi le
items.task: Say the shop door is still open (a state, not the moment it opened).
items.zh: 商店的门还开着。
items.py: shāng diàn de mén hái kāi zhe
items.en: The shop door is still open.
items.why: 还 plus 开着 describes a state that continues. 开了 only reported the change.

items.src_py: tā zài chuān qiú yī
items.task: Say he is wearing the jersey, not putting it on.
items.zh: 他穿着球衣。
items.py: tā chuān zhe qiú yī
items.en: He is wearing a jersey.
items.why: 穿着 describes the state; 在穿 was the action of putting it on.

items.src: 她笑了，然后把零钱找给了我。
items.src_py: tā xiào le rán hòu bǎ líng qián zhǎo gěi le wǒ
items.task: Make the smile the manner of giving the change: one clause with 着.
items.zh: 她笑着把零钱找给了我。
items.py: tā xiào zhe bǎ líng qián zhǎo gěi le wǒ
items.en: She gave me my change with a smile.
items.why: The smile accompanies the giving, so 笑着 goes first and 找给了 carries the 了.

items.src: 他一边听音乐，一边跑步。
items.src_py: tā yī biān tīng yīn yuè yī biān pǎo bù
items.task: Say it with 着: listening is the background.
items.zh: 他听着音乐跑步。
items.py: tā tīng zhe yīn yuè pǎo bù
items.en: He runs while listening to music.
items.why: 听着音乐 becomes the background to the main verb 跑步; 着 goes on the first verb only.

items.src: 有一张球赛海报，挂在墙上。
items.src_py: yǒu yī zhāng qiú sài hǎi bào guà zài qiáng shàng
items.task: Start from the place: a poster is hanging on the wall.
items.zh: 墙上挂着一张球赛海报。
items.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng qiú sài hǎi bào
items.en: There is a match poster hanging on the wall.
items.why: Place + 挂着 + 一张 + noun; the thing comes after the verb.

items.src_py: nǐ xiān zuò xià ba
items.task: Change it to tell him to stay seated (he is already sitting).
items.zh: 你先坐着吧。
items.py: nǐ xiān zuò zhe ba
items.en: Just stay seated for now.
items.why: 坐着 tells someone to keep the seated state; 坐下 tells them to sit down.

items.src_py: chāo shì de mén kāi zhe
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 超市的门没开着。
items.py: chāo shì de mén méi kāi zhe
items.en: The supermarket door isn't open.
items.why: A 着 state is denied with 没, never 不.

items.src_py: nǐ tǎng zhe kàn qiú sài
items.task: Turn it into a warning: don't ...
items.zh: 别躺着看球赛。
items.py: bié tǎng zhe kàn qiú sài
items.en: Don't watch the match lying down.
items.why: 别 replaces the subject and keeps 着 on the posture verb.

items.src_py: dì di zuò zài shā fā shàng
items.task: Move the place in front of the verb and keep the state with 着.
items.zh: 弟弟在沙发上坐着。
items.py: dì di zài shā fā shàng zuò zhe
items.en: My younger brother is sitting on the sofa.
items.why: With the place in front as 在沙发上, the verb ends with 着 instead of 在.

items.src_py: wǒ men pái zhe duì
items.task: Say we queued for twenty minutes (a duration).
items.zh: 我们排了二十分钟的队。
items.py: wǒ men pái le èr shí fēn zhōng de duì
items.en: We queued for twenty minutes.
items.why: A duration needs 了, not 着.

items.s: 超市的灯一直亮了，没人关。
items.s_py: chāo shì de dēng yī zhí liàng le méi rén guān
items.zh: 超市的灯一直亮着，没人关。
items.py: chāo shì de dēng yī zhí liàng zhe méi rén guān
items.en: The supermarket lights have been on all along and nobody turned them off.
items.why: 一直 describes a continuing state, so 亮着. 了 reports a change of state and cannot be stretched by 一直.

items.s: 她早上穿着球衣出门，晚上回来还穿着呢。
items.s_py: tā zǎo shang chuān zhe qiú yī chū mén wǎn shang huí lái hái chuān zhe ne
items.zh: 她早上穿着球衣出门，晚上回来还穿着呢。
items.py: tā zǎo shang chuān zhe qiú yī chū mén wǎn shang huí lái hái chuān zhe ne
items.en: She went out in her jersey in the morning and was still wearing it when she came back at night.
items.why: Both 穿着 are right: the first is the posture-like manner of leaving, the second a state that still holds, with 还 and 呢.

items.s: 侧门在开，所以屋里有点儿冷。
items.s_py: cè mén zài kāi suǒ yǐ wū lǐ yǒu diǎn r lěng
items.zh: 侧门开着，所以屋里有点儿冷。
items.py: cè mén kāi zhe suǒ yǐ wū lǐ yǒu diǎn r lěng
items.en: The side door is open, so it's a bit cold inside.
items.why: A door that stays open is a state, 开着. 在开 would mean someone or something is opening it right now, which does not explain a cold room.

items.s: 妈妈在试衣间换衣服，你在外面等一下。
items.s_py: mā ma zài shì yī jiān huàn yī fu nǐ zài wài miàn děng yī xià
items.zh: 妈妈在试衣间换衣服，你在外面等一下。
items.py: mā ma zài shì yī jiān huàn yī fu nǐ zài wài miàn děng yī xià
items.en: Mom is changing in the fitting room, so wait outside for a moment.
items.why: Changing clothes is an action in progress, so 在换衣服 is right; 换着衣服 would sound unfinished.

items.s: 弟弟哭跑出了球场。
items.s_py: dì di kū pǎo chū le qiú chǎng
items.zh: 弟弟哭着跑出了球场。
items.py: dì di kū zhe pǎo chū le qiú chǎng
items.en: My younger brother ran out of the pitch crying.
items.why: The manner verb 哭 needs 着 before the main verb 跑出. Without it the two verbs do not link.

items.s: 球迷们唱着歌，一路走到了体育场门口。
items.s_py: qiú mí men chàng zhe gē yī lù zǒu dào le tǐ yù chǎng mén kǒu
items.zh: 球迷们唱着歌，一路走到了体育场门口。
items.py: qiú mí men chàng zhe gē yī lù zǒu dào le tǐ yù chǎng mén kǒu
items.en: The fans walked all the way to the stadium entrance singing.
items.why: 唱着歌 is the background manner and 走到了 the main action with its 了, so the sentence is correct.

items.s: 货架上在摆三双新球鞋。
items.s_py: huò jià shàng zài bǎi sān shuāng xīn qiú xié
items.zh: 货架上摆着三双新球鞋。
items.py: huò jià shàng bǎi zhe sān shuāng xīn qiú xié
items.en: Three pairs of new sneakers are displayed on the shelf.
items.why: Describing what is sitting somewhere uses Place + 摆着 + noun with no 在 before the verb.

items.s: 球场边的椅子上坐着几个小孩，手里都拿着冰淇淋。
items.s_py: qiú chǎng biān de yǐ zi shàng zuò zhe jǐ gè xiǎo hái shǒu lǐ dōu ná zhe bīng qí lín
items.zh: 球场边的椅子上坐着几个小孩，手里都拿着冰淇淋。
items.py: qiú chǎng biān de yǐ zi shàng zuò zhe jǐ gè xiǎo hái shǒu lǐ dōu ná zhe bīng qí lín
items.en: A few children are sitting on the chairs at the side of the pitch, each holding an ice cream.
items.why: Both parts are correct: Place + 坐着 + noun, and 手里拿着 for what is held.

items.s: 一张海报挂着门上。
items.s_py: yī zhāng hǎi bào guà zhe mén shàng
items.zh: 门上挂着一张海报。
items.py: mén shàng guà zhe yī zhāng hǎi bào
items.en: A poster hangs on the door.
items.why: The place goes first, then 挂着, then the thing. 着 cannot be followed directly by a place.

items.s: 你坐了吧，我来付钱。
items.s_py: nǐ zuò le ba wǒ lái fù qián
items.zh: 你坐着吧，我来付钱。
items.py: nǐ zuò zhe ba wǒ lái fù qián
items.en: Stay seated, I'll pay.
items.why: To tell someone to remain sitting, use 坐着. 坐了吧 is not a command pattern.

items.s: 这张球票你先拿着，进场的时候要给工作人员看。
items.s_py: zhè zhāng qiú piào nǐ xiān ná zhe jìn chǎng de shí hou yào gěi gōng zuò rén yuán kàn
items.zh: 这张球票你先拿着，进场的时候要给工作人员看。
items.py: zhè zhāng qiú piào nǐ xiān ná zhe jìn chǎng de shí hou yào gěi gōng zuò rén yuán kàn
items.en: Hold on to this ticket for now; you'll have to show it to the staff when you go in.
items.why: 拿着 in a command means keep holding it, which is correct here.

items.s: 大家别站着，快坐下看比赛吧。
items.s_py: dà jiā bié zhàn zhe kuài zuò xià kàn bǐ sài ba
items.zh: 大家别站着，快坐下看比赛吧。
items.py: dà jiā bié zhàn zhe kuài zuò xià kàn bǐ sài ba
items.en: Everyone, don't just stand there; sit down and watch the match.
items.why: 别 + V着 is the right way to tell people not to stay in a state; 不 would not work here.

items.s: 他今天不戴着手表，所以不知道现在几点。
items.s_py: tā jīn tiān bù dài zhe shǒu biǎo suǒ yǐ bù zhī dào xiàn zài jǐ diǎn
items.zh: 他今天没戴着手表，所以不知道现在几点。
items.py: tā jīn tiān méi dài zhe shǒu biǎo suǒ yǐ bù zhī dào xiàn zài jǐ diǎn
items.en: He wasn't wearing a watch today, so he doesn't know what time it is.
items.why: A 着 state is denied with 没. 不戴着 is not used.

items.s: 她喝茶着看球赛。
items.s_py: tā hē chá zhe kàn qiú sài
items.zh: 她喝着茶看球赛。
items.py: tā hē zhe chá kàn qiú sài
items.en: She watches the match while drinking tea.
items.why: 着 sticks to the verb and comes before the object: 喝着茶.

items.s: 老人坐着在长椅上看球赛。
items.s_py: lǎo rén zuò zhe zài cháng yǐ shàng kàn qiú sài
items.zh: 老人坐在长椅上看球赛。
items.py: lǎo rén zuò zài cháng yǐ shàng kàn qiú sài
items.en: The old man sits on the bench watching the match.
items.why: Verb + 在 + place does not take 着. Say 坐在长椅上, or put the place first.

items.s: 他在体育馆门口站着，手里拿着两张球票。
items.s_py: tā zài tǐ yù guǎn mén kǒu zhàn zhe shǒu lǐ ná zhe liǎng zhāng qiú piào
items.zh: 他在体育馆门口站着，手里拿着两张球票。
items.py: tā zài tǐ yù guǎn mén kǒu zhàn zhe shǒu lǐ ná zhe liǎng zhāng qiú piào
items.en: He is standing at the entrance of the stadium holding two tickets.
items.why: 在 + place + verb + 着 is a correct shape, and 手里拿着 follows the usual pattern.

items.s: 我认识着这家店的老板。
items.s_py: wǒ rèn shi zhe zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn
items.zh: 我认识这家店的老板。
items.py: wǒ rèn shi zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn
items.en: I know the owner of this shop.
items.why: 认识 is a state verb with nothing to hold and never takes 着.

items.s: 他看见着我，但是没打招呼。
items.s_py: tā kàn jiàn zhe wǒ dàn shì méi dǎ zhāo hu
items.zh: 他看见我，但是没打招呼。
items.py: tā kàn jiàn wǒ dàn shì méi dǎ zhāo hu
items.en: He saw me but didn't say hello.
items.why: 看见 already has a result complement, so 着 cannot follow it.

items.s: 我们等着教练一个半小时了。
items.s_py: wǒ men děng zhe jiào liàn yī gè bàn xiǎo shí le
items.zh: 我们等了教练一个半小时了。
items.py: wǒ men děng le jiào liàn yī gè bàn xiǎo shí le
items.en: We have been waiting for the coach for an hour and a half.
items.why: A duration follows the verb, so it takes 了, not 着.

items.s: 我在体育用品店挑了半天，最后什么也没买。
items.s_py: wǒ zài tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn tiāo le bàn tiān zuì hòu shén me yě méi mǎi
items.zh: 我在体育用品店挑了半天，最后什么也没买。
items.py: wǒ zài tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn tiāo le bàn tiān zuì hòu shén me yě méi mǎi
items.en: I browsed in the sports shop for ages and in the end bought nothing.
items.why: 半天 is a duration, so 挑了半天 is right; 挑着半天 is not possible.

items.q: 雨还在下，他手里一直拿___一把伞。
items.zh: 雨还在下，他手里一直拿着一把伞。
items.py: yǔ hái zài xià tā shǒu lǐ yì zhí ná zhe yī bǎ sǎn
items.en: It is still raining, and he has been holding an umbrella the whole time.
items.why: 一直 describes a state that keeps holding, so 着 goes after 拿. 了 would report the moment he picked it up, and 过 would mean he had held one at some time before.

items.q: 天气热了，可是她还穿___毛衣。
items.zh: 天气热了，可是她还穿着毛衣。
items.py: tiān qì rè le kě shì tā hái chuān zhe máo yī
items.en: It has turned hot, but she is still wearing a sweater.
items.why: 还 points to a state that has not ended, so 穿着 says she still has it on. 了 would report putting it on, which clashes with 还, and 过 means she has worn one before.

items.q: 教室里的灯一直亮___，没有人关。
items.zh: 教室里的灯一直亮着，没有人关。
items.py: jiào shì lǐ de dēng yì zhí liàng zhe méi yǒu rén guān
items.en: The light in the classroom has been on all along, and nobody turned it off.
items.why: 一直 plus nobody turning it off describes a lasting state, so 亮着. 了 reports the light coming on, and 过 only an earlier experience.

items.q: 夏天的晚上，我们家的窗户总是开___，很凉快。
items.zh: 夏天的晚上，我们家的窗户总是开着，很凉快。
items.py: xià tiān de wǎn shàng wǒ men jiā de chuāng hù zǒng shì kāi zhe hěn liáng kuài
items.en: On summer nights our windows are always open, and it is cool.
items.why: 总是 describes how things usually stand, a held state, so 开着. 了 reports a single change and 过 an experience; neither fits a habitual scene.

items.q: 风一吹，门突然开___，我吓了一跳。
items.zh: 风一吹，门突然开了，我吓了一跳。
items.py: fēng yī chuī mén tū rán kāi le wǒ xià le yī tiào
items.en: The wind blew and the door suddenly opened. I jumped.
items.why: 突然 marks a change that has just happened, so 了. 着 describes a door that is already standing open and cannot go with a sudden event.

items.q: 他头上一直戴___一顶红帽子，怎么也不摘。
items.zh: 他头上一直戴着一顶红帽子，怎么也不摘。
items.py: tā tóu shàng yì zhí dài zhe yī dǐng hóng mào zi zěn me yě bù zhāi
items.en: He keeps a red hat on his head and never takes it off.
items.why: 一直 and 不摘 show the hat stays on, a held state, so 着. 了 would say he put it on once, and 过 would say he had worn it at some earlier time.

items.q: 朋友家的大门还关___，我们按了半天门铃也没人来开。
items.zh: 朋友家的大门还关着，我们按了半天门铃也没人来开。
items.py: péng yǒu jiā de dà mén hái guān zhe wǒ men àn le bàn tiān mén líng yě méi rén lái kāi
items.en: The gate of my friend's house was still shut; we rang the bell for ages and nobody came to open it.
items.why: 还 says the gate is still in the shut state, so 关着. 了 would report someone closing it, which does not fit 还, and 过 is experience.

items.s: 房间里的灯还亮了呢。
items.s_py: fáng jiān lǐ de dēng hái liàng le ne
items.zh: 房间里的灯还亮着呢。
items.py: fáng jiān lǐ de dēng hái liàng zhe ne
items.en: The light in the room is still on.
items.why: A light that is still on is a held state, so it needs 着 with 还 and 呢. 亮了 reports it coming on and cannot sit with 还 … 呢 here.

items.s: 已经十二月了，朋友的院子里还开着几朵花。
items.s_py: yǐ jīng shí èr yuè le péng yǒu de yuàn zi lǐ hái kāi zhe jǐ duǒ huā
items.zh: 已经十二月了，朋友的院子里还开着几朵花。
items.py: yǐ jīng shí èr yuè le péng yǒu de yuàn zi lǐ hái kāi zhe jǐ duǒ huā
items.en: It is already December, and a few flowers are still in bloom in my friend's yard.
items.why: Correct. 开着 describes flowers that are still open, and 几朵花 can follow it directly. 了 would only say they bloomed at some point.

items.zh: 朋友一直穿着那件红外套。
items.py: péng yǒu yì zhí chuān zhe nà jiàn hóng wài tào
items.en: My friend has been wearing that red coat all along.
items.why: 一直 goes before the verb, and 着 stays glued to 穿 with the object after it. 穿着 describes the coat as a lasting state.

items.src_py: tā dài shàng le yī tiáo lán wéi jīn
items.task: Say he is wearing the scarf now (a state).
items.zh: 他戴着一条蓝围巾。
items.py: tā dài zhe yī tiáo lán wéi jīn
items.en: He is wearing a blue scarf.
items.why: 戴上了 reports putting it on; 戴着 describes the state after that. 着 sits right after the verb and the object keeps its measure word.

items.q: 她___外套，你等一下，马上就好。
items.zh: 她在穿外套，你等一下，马上就好。
items.py: tā zài chuān wài tào nǐ děng yí xià mǎ shàng jiù hǎo
items.en: She is putting her coat on, wait a moment, she will be ready soon.
items.why: 等一下 and 马上就好 show the dressing is still happening, so 在穿. 穿着 describes a coat already on, and 穿过 only says she has worn it before.

items.q: 你看，今天特别冷，小李___一件厚外套。
items.zh: 你看，今天特别冷，小李穿着一件厚外套。
items.py: nǐ kàn jīn tiān tè bié lěng xiǎo lǐ chuān zhe yī jiàn hòu wài tào
items.en: Look, it is very cold today and Xiao Li is wearing a thick coat.
items.why: Here English is "is wearing", a state, so 穿着. 在穿 would mean he is in the middle of putting it on, and 穿过 only that he has worn one before.

items.q: 电梯门___，大家别着急往外走。
items.zh: 电梯门在开，大家别着急往外走。
items.py: diàn tī mén zài kāi dà jiā bié zháo jí wǎng wài zǒu
items.en: The lift door is opening, so don't rush out.
items.why: The cue is the door in motion, so 在开. 开着 would say it is already standing open, and 开过 that it has opened before.

items.q: 我朋友___打电话，你过一会儿再来吧。
items.zh: 我朋友在打电话，你过一会儿再来吧。
items.py: wǒ péng yǒu zài dǎ diàn huà nǐ guò yī huì r zài lái ba
items.en: My friend is on the phone, so come back in a little while.
items.why: 打电话 is an activity someone is busy doing, so 在 goes before the verb. 着 cannot mark a bare activity as in progress here, and 了 would report a finished call.

items.q: 朋友家的大门___，我们进不去。
items.zh: 朋友家的大门关着，我们进不去。
items.py: péng yǒu jiā de dà mén guān zhe wǒ men jìn bù qù
items.en: The gate of my friend's house is shut, so we can't get in.
items.why: The gate is simply in the shut state, so 关着. 在关 would need someone closing it right now, and 关过 only an earlier closing.

items.q: 客人快到了，妈妈___桌子，你去帮她拿几个盘子吧。
items.zh: 客人快到了，妈妈在摆桌子，你去帮她拿几个盘子吧。
items.py: kè rén kuài dào le mā mā zài bǎi zhuō zi nǐ qù bāng tā ná jǐ gè pán zi ba
items.en: The guests are almost here and Mum is laying the table; go and help her with some plates.
items.why: Mum is busy with the task and needs help, so the action in progress, 在摆. 摆着桌子 does not describe a state here, and 摆过 is experience.

items.q: 八点了，那家商店的灯还___，老板大概还没走。
items.zh: 八点了，那家商店的灯还亮着，老板大概还没走。
items.py: bā diǎn le nà jiā shāng diàn de dēng hái liàng zhe lǎo bǎn dà gài hái méi zǒu
items.en: It is eight o'clock and the shop's light is still on; the owner probably has not left.
items.why: A light that stays lit is a state, so 亮着 with 还. 亮了 reports it coming on, which clashes with 还, and 亮过 would only say it was on at some earlier time.

items.s: 窗户在开，所以屋里很冷。
items.s_py: chuāng hù zài kāi suǒ yǐ wū lǐ hěn lěng
items.zh: 窗户开着，所以屋里很冷。
items.py: chuāng hù kāi zhe suǒ yǐ wū lǐ hěn lěng
items.en: The window is open, so it is cold inside.
items.why: "Is open" is a state, so the window needs 开着. 在开 would mean it is in the middle of opening, which does not explain the cold.

items.s: 我去敲门的时候，他正在穿衣服，所以没听见。
items.s_py: wǒ qù qiāo mén de shí hòu tā zhèng zài chuān yī fu suǒ yǐ méi tīng jiàn
items.zh: 我去敲门的时候，他正在穿衣服，所以没听见。
items.py: wǒ qù qiāo mén de shí hòu tā zhèng zài chuān yī fu suǒ yǐ méi tīng jiàn
items.en: When I knocked he was getting dressed, so he did not hear.
items.why: Correct. 正在穿 is the act of dressing, which explains why he was busy and did not hear. 穿着 would only describe clothes he already had on.

items.zh: 小李在给朋友打电话。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ zài gěi péng yǒu dǎ diàn huà
items.en: Xiao Li is calling a friend.
items.why: 在 comes before the whole verb phrase 给朋友打电话 to show the call is in progress. It cannot be placed after 给朋友.

items.zh: 门口那个人穿着一件黑大衣。
items.py: mén kǒu nà ge rén chuān zhe yī jiàn hēi dà yī
items.en: The person at the door is wearing a black overcoat.
items.why: "Is wearing" is a state, so 穿着 follows the subject directly and the object keeps its number and measure word.

items.src_py: bà bà zài guān chuāng hù
items.task: Say the window is still closed (a state), starting with 窗户.
items.zh: 窗户还关着。
items.py: chuāng hù hái guān zhe
items.en: The window is still closed.
items.why: The state of being closed is 关着, while 在关 is the act of closing. 还 sits before the verb phrase.

items.q: 朋友们笑___说：“欢迎欢迎！”
items.zh: 朋友们笑着说：“欢迎欢迎！”
items.py: péng yǒu men xiào zhe shuō huān yíng huān yíng
items.en: My friends said with a smile, "Welcome, welcome!"
items.why: 笑 is the manner, so it takes 着 and the main verb 说 follows. 了 would make smiling a finished first step, and 地 is not used after a bare verb like 笑.

items.q: 我们坐___聊天，一点也不累。
items.zh: 我们坐着聊天，一点也不累。
items.py: wǒ men zuò zhe liáo tiān yì diǎn yě bù lèi
items.en: We chat sitting down and are not tired at all.
items.why: 坐 is the posture in which the chatting happens, so 着 goes on 坐. 在 would need a place after it, and 坐了聊天 does not join the two verbs.

items.q: 下雨天，我喜欢躺___听雨声。
items.zh: 下雨天，我喜欢躺着听雨声。
items.py: xià yǔ tiān wǒ xǐ huān tǎng zhe tīng yǔ shēng
items.en: On rainy days I like to listen to the rain lying down.
items.why: 躺 is the background posture of 听, so it takes 着. 躺在 needs a place such as 床上, and 躺了听 does not link the two verbs.

items.q: 弟弟哭___告诉我，朋友把他的玩具弄坏了。
items.zh: 弟弟哭着告诉我，朋友把他的玩具弄坏了。
items.py: dì di kū zhe gào sù wǒ péng yǒu bǎ tā de wán jù nòng huài le
items.en: My little brother told me, crying, that his friend had broken his toy.
items.why: 哭 describes how he told me, so it takes 着 and 告诉 is the main verb. 在 and 地 do not attach a bare verb to a following verb this way.

items.q: 我喜欢___音乐散步，一个人也不觉得无聊。
items.zh: 我喜欢听着音乐散步，一个人也不觉得无聊。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huān tīng zhe yīn yuè sàn bù yí gè rén yě bù jué dé wú liáo
items.en: I like to walk while listening to music, and I do not get bored on my own.
items.why: 听 is the background activity, so 听着 and 散步 is the main verb. 听了 would make listening a finished step before the walk, and 听过 is experience.

items.q: 别___手机跟朋友说话，这样不礼貌。
items.zh: 别看着手机跟朋友说话，这样不礼貌。
items.py: bié kàn zhe shǒu jī gēn péng yǒu shuō huà zhè yàng bù lǐ mào
items.en: Don't look at your phone while talking to a friend; it is rude.
