items.why: The phone-watching is the accompanying action, marked by 着 on the first verb. 看了 and 看过 report a completed action or experience and cannot be forbidden this way.

items.q: 朋友们围___桌子坐下，一边吃一边聊起了暑假的计划。
items.zh: 朋友们围着桌子坐下，一边吃一边聊起了暑假的计划。
items.py: péng yǒu men wéi zhe zhuō zi zuò xià yī biān chī yī biān liáo qǐ le shǔ jià de jì huà
items.en: My friends sat down around the table and chatted about their summer plans while eating.
items.why: 围着桌子 is the manner or arrangement of sitting, so 着 goes on 围. 围了桌子坐下 does not join the verbs, and 围在 needs a place word.

items.q: 雨突然下大了，小王拉___我的手往前跑，一路上笑个不停。
items.zh: 雨突然下大了，小王拉着我的手往前跑，一路上笑个不停。
items.py: yǔ tū rán xià dà le xiǎo wáng lā zhe wǒ de shǒu wǎng qián pǎo yī lù shàng xiào gè bù tíng
items.en: The rain suddenly got heavy, and Xiao Wang ran ahead holding my hand, laughing all the way.
items.why: 拉 is how he ran, the background action, so it takes 着 and 跑 is the main verb. 拉在 needs a place and 拉过 is experience.

items.s: 小王躺看电视，一直没动。
items.s_py: xiǎo wáng tǎng kàn diàn shì yì zhí méi dòng
items.zh: 小王躺着看电视，一直没动。
items.py: xiǎo wáng tǎng zhe kàn diàn shì yì zhí méi dòng
items.en: Xiao Wang lay watching TV and never moved.
items.why: 躺 is the posture of watching, so it needs 着 to join the verbs. Two bare verbs in a row do not work here.

items.s: 弟弟站说着话，一点儿也不害羞。
items.s_py: dì di zhàn shuō zhe huà yì diǎn r yě bù hài xiū
items.zh: 弟弟站着说话，一点儿也不害羞。
items.py: dì di zhàn zhe shuō huà yì diǎn r yě bù hài xiū
items.en: My little brother stands up and talks without being shy at all.
items.why: 着 marks the background posture, so it sits on 站, not on the main verb 说. 站说着话 swaps the roles.

items.s: 我们笑着聊了一个下午，谁也没注意到外面下起了大雨。
items.s_py: wǒ men xiào zhe liáo le yí gè xià wǔ shuí yě méi zhù yì dào wài miàn xià qǐ le dà yǔ
items.zh: 我们笑着聊了一个下午，谁也没注意到外面下起了大雨。
items.py: wǒ men xiào zhe liáo le yí gè xià wǔ shuí yě méi zhù yì dào wài miàn xià qǐ le dà yǔ
items.en: We chatted away with smiles all afternoon and nobody noticed the heavy rain that had started outside.
items.why: Correct. 笑着 is the manner and 了 belongs to the main verb 聊, with the duration after it. The 着 stays on the first verb.

items.zh: 小王笑着说他明天有空。
items.py: xiǎo wáng xiào zhe shuō tā míng tiān yǒu kòng
items.en: Xiao Wang said with a smile that he is free tomorrow.
items.why: 笑着 is the manner and goes before the main verb 说; what he said follows.

items.zh: 我们坐着喝茶，聊了一个下午。
items.py: wǒ men zuò zhe hē chá liáo le yí gè xià wǔ
items.en: We sat drinking tea and chatted for a whole afternoon.
items.why: 坐着 is the background posture and comes before the verb 喝茶. 了 belongs to 聊, followed by the duration.

items.src: 小明一边淋雨，一边走回家。
items.src_py: xiǎo míng yī biān lín yǔ yī biān zǒu huí jiā
items.task: Rewrite with 着 on the background verb.
items.zh: 小明淋着雨走回家。
items.py: xiǎo míng lín zhe yǔ zǒu huí jiā
items.en: Xiao Ming walked home in the rain.
items.why: 淋 is the circumstance of the walk, so it takes 着 before its object 雨, and the main verb phrase 走回家 follows.

items.q: 桌子上放___两杯热茶。
items.zh: 桌子上放着两杯热茶。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe liǎng bēi rè chá
items.en: There are two cups of hot tea on the table.
items.why: Place + verb + 着 + number-measure-noun describes what is sitting there. 放在 needs a thing before it and a place after it, and 放过 is experience.

items.q: 墙上___一张世界地图。
items.zh: 墙上挂着一张世界地图。
items.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng shì jiè dì tú
items.en: There is a world map hanging on the wall.
items.why: The place comes first and the new thing follows 挂着. 在挂 would need someone hanging it right now, and 挂在 would need the map first and a place after it.

items.q: 窗外的雪地上___着一串长长的脚印。
items.zh: 窗外的雪地上留着一串长长的脚印。
items.py: chuāng wài de xuě dì shàng liú zhe yī chuàn cháng cháng de jiǎo yìn
items.en: A long line of footprints is left on the snow outside the window.
items.why: Place + verb + 着 + thing needs a real verb before 着, and 留 (leave behind) fits. 在 and 到 are not verbs that can take 着 here.

items.q: 咖啡馆门口___一辆红色的自行车，是朋友的。
items.zh: 咖啡馆门口停着一辆红色的自行车，是朋友的。
items.py: kā fēi guǎn mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng hóng sè de zì xíng chē shì péng yǒu de
items.en: A red bicycle is parked at the cafe door; it belongs to my friend.
items.why: Place + 停着 + 一辆 + noun describes what is parked there. 停在 needs the bicycle first, and 在停 would need someone parking it right now.

items.q: 沙发上___一个人，是我的好朋友。
items.zh: 沙发上躺着一个人，是我的好朋友。
items.py: shā fā shàng tǎng zhe yí gè rén shì wǒ de hǎo péng yǒu
items.en: There is someone lying on the sofa; it is my good friend.
items.why: The place opens the sentence and the new person follows 躺着. 躺在 would put a place after the verb, and 在躺 is not used for a person introduced as new.

items.q: 黑板上___明天郊游的时间和地点，大家别忘了。
items.zh: 黑板上写着明天郊游的时间和地点，大家别忘了。
items.py: hēi bǎn shàng xiě zhe míng tiān jiāo yóu de shí jiān hé dì diǎn dà jiā bié wàng le
items.en: The time and place of tomorrow's outing are written on the board; don't forget.
items.why: Place + 写着 + thing says what is written there. 写在 needs the thing first, and 写过 would say it was written at some earlier time.

items.q: 窗台上___三盆花，春天一到，它们就开了。
items.zh: 窗台上摆着三盆花，春天一到，它们就开了。
items.py: chuāng tái shàng bǎi zhe sān pén huā chūn tiān yī dào tā men jiù kāi le
items.en: There are three pots of flowers on the windowsill; when spring comes they bloom.
items.why: Place + 摆着 + number + measure + noun describes what sits there. 摆在 needs the pots before it, and 在摆 needs a person doing it now.

items.s: 两把椅子放着桌子旁边。
items.s_py: liǎng bǎ yǐ zi fàng zhe zhuō zi páng biān
items.zh: 桌子旁边放着两把椅子。
items.py: zhuō zi páng biān fàng zhe liǎng bǎ yǐ zi
items.en: There are two chairs next to the table.
items.why: The place must come first, then 放着, then the thing. 着 cannot be followed directly by a place word.

items.s: 门口站着三个人，他们都是我的朋友。
items.s_py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe sān gè rén tā men dōu shì wǒ de péng yǒu
items.zh: 门口站着三个人，他们都是我的朋友。
items.py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe sān gè rén tā men dōu shì wǒ de péng yǒu
items.en: Three people are standing at the door; they are all my friends.
items.why: Correct. The place opens the sentence and the new people come after 站着 with a number and measure word.

items.zh: 墙上挂着一张画。
items.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng huà
items.en: There is a painting hanging on the wall.
items.why: Place first, then 挂着, then 一张 and the thing. No 在 goes before the verb.

items.zh: 河边坐着几个钓鱼的人。
items.py: hé biān zuò zhe jǐ gè diào yú de rén
items.en: A few people are sitting by the river fishing.
items.why: Place first, then 坐着, then number and noun. The people are new information, so they come last.

items.zh: 冬天的公园里站着一个大雪人。
items.py: dōng tiān de gōng yuán lǐ zhàn zhe yí gè dà xuě rén
items.en: In the park in winter there stands a big snowman.
items.why: The place phrase comes first, then 站着 and the new thing with 一个. A thing standing somewhere takes this pattern.

items.src_py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī wǎn rè tāng
items.task: Rewrite with 放着 to show how it sits there.
items.zh: 桌子上放着一碗热汤。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī wǎn rè tāng
items.en: There is a bowl of hot soup on the table.
items.why: Replacing 有 with 放着 adds how the bowl sits there. The place stays first and the new thing follows with number and measure word.

items.q: 你___这把伞，我去买点东西。
items.zh: 你拿着这把伞，我去买点东西。
items.py: nǐ ná zhe zhè bǎ sǎn wǒ qù mǎi diǎn dōng xī
items.en: Hold this umbrella, I am going to buy a few things.
items.why: Hold-and-keep is 拿着, a command to stay in that state. 拿了 reports a completed taking and 在拿 describes what someone is doing right now.

items.q: 我去买票，你在这儿等___。
items.zh: 我去买票，你在这儿等着。
items.py: wǒ qù mǎi piào nǐ zài zhè r děng zhe
items.en: I'll go and buy the tickets; you wait here.
items.why: A command to keep waiting takes 着. 了 and 过 report something already done or experienced, which cannot be an order.

items.q: 你听___，下个月我们要去海边玩，先别告诉别人。
items.zh: 你听着，下个月我们要去海边玩，先别告诉别人。
items.py: nǐ tīng zhe xià gè yuè wǒ men yào qù hǎi biān wán xiān bié gào sù bié rén
items.en: Listen, we are going to the seaside next month; don't tell anyone yet.
items.why: An attention-getting command takes 着: keep listening. 了 and 过 report something already done and cannot open a command.

items.q: 你坐___吧，别站起来，我自己去拿。
items.zh: 你坐着吧，别站起来，我自己去拿。
items.py: nǐ zuò zhe ba bié zhàn qǐ lái wǒ zì jǐ qù ná
items.en: Stay seated, don't get up; I'll fetch it myself.
items.why: The point is to stay in the sitting state, so 坐着. 坐了 and 坐过 report something done and cannot be an order not to get up.

items.q: 这是我家的地址，你记___，下雪天路不好走。
items.zh: 这是我家的地址，你记着，下雪天路不好走。
items.py: zhè shì wǒ jiā de dì zhǐ nǐ jì zhe xià xuě tiān lù bù hǎo zǒu
items.en: This is my address, keep it in mind; the roads are bad on snowy days.
items.why: 记着 means keep it in mind, a command to maintain a state. 记了 and 记过 report a past action and cannot be an order.

items.q: 外面在下雨，你把我的雨衣带___，回家的时候用。
items.zh: 外面在下雨，你把我的雨衣带着，回家的时候用。
items.py: wài miàn zài xià yǔ nǐ bǎ wǒ de yǔ yī dài zhe huí jiā de shí hòu yòng
items.en: It is raining outside; take my raincoat along and use it on your way home.
items.why: 带着 is a command to keep it with you. 带了 reports a finished action, and 到 is not a particle that can follow 带 here.

items.q: 天气预报说晚上会降温，你把这件外套穿___，别着凉。
items.zh: 天气预报说晚上会降温，你把这件外套穿着，别着凉。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō wǎn shàng huì jiàng wēn nǐ bǎ zhè jiàn wài tào chuān zhe bié zháo liáng
items.en: The forecast says it will get cold tonight; keep this coat on so you don't catch a cold.
items.why: The command is to keep the coat on, so 穿着. 穿了 and 穿过 report something done and cannot be an order to keep a state.

items.s: 你听了，这件事很重要。
items.s_py: nǐ tīng le zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòng yào
items.zh: 你听着，这件事很重要。
items.py: nǐ tīng zhe zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòng yào
items.en: Listen, this matter is important.
items.why: A command to listen takes 着. 了 turns it into a report of something already done and cannot open this kind of warning.

items.s: 你先别站起来，坐着吧，朋友们自己会找位子的。
items.s_py: nǐ xiān bié zhàn qǐ lái zuò zhe ba péng yǒu men zì jǐ huì zhǎo wèi zi de
items.zh: 你先别站起来，坐着吧，朋友们自己会找位子的。
items.py: nǐ xiān bié zhàn qǐ lái zuò zhe ba péng yǒu men zì jǐ huì zhǎo wèi zi de
items.en: Don't get up, just stay seated; my friends will find seats on their own.
items.why: Correct. 坐着吧 tells someone already sitting to stay that way, and 别站起来 supports it. 坐吧 would invite someone to sit down.

items.src: 我去开门，你拿一下这把伞。
items.src_py: wǒ qù kāi mén nǐ ná yī xià zhè bǎ sǎn
items.task: Say "hold this umbrella" with 着.
items.zh: 我去开门，你拿着这把伞。
items.py: wǒ qù kāi mén nǐ ná zhe zhè bǎ sǎn
items.en: I'll go and open the door; you hold this umbrella.
items.why: 拿着 asks the person to keep holding it while I do something else. 拿一下 would only ask for a quick act.

items.q: 门___锁着，你一推就开了。
items.zh: 门没锁着，你一推就开了。
items.py: mén méi suǒ zhe nǐ yī tuī jiù kāi le
items.en: The door is not locked; just push and it opens.
items.why: The state 锁着 is denied with 没, never 不. 别 gives a command and does not describe the door.

items.q: 他今天___戴着帽子，脸都晒红了。
items.zh: 他今天没戴着帽子，脸都晒红了。
items.py: tā jīn tiān méi dài zhe mào zi liǎn dōu shài hóng le
items.en: He was not wearing a hat today, and his face got sunburnt.
items.why: A 着 state that is not the case in the past is denied with 没. 不 + verb + 着 is not used, and 别 is for commands.

items.q: 天太冷了，别站___，快进来坐吧。
items.zh: 天太冷了，别站着，快进来坐吧。
items.py: tiān tài lěng le bié zhàn zhe kuài jìn lái zuò ba
items.en: It is freezing; don't just stand there, come in and sit down.
items.why: 别 + verb + 着 says do not stay in that posture. 别站过 and 别站在 do not give this meaning.

items.q: 别躺___看手机，对眼睛不好。
items.zh: 别躺着看手机，对眼睛不好。
items.py: bié tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī duì yǎn jīng bù hǎo
items.en: Don't look at your phone lying down; it is bad for your eyes.
items.why: 别 + 躺着 forbids the posture while doing the main verb. 躺了 and 躺过 do not join with 看手机.

items.q: 外面下雪了，你别开___窗户睡觉，会感冒的。
items.zh: 外面下雪了，你别开着窗户睡觉，会感冒的。
items.py: wài miàn xià xuě le nǐ bié kāi zhe chuāng hù shuì jiào huì gǎn mào de
items.en: It is snowing outside, so don't sleep with the window open; you will catch a cold.
items.why: 别开着窗户睡觉 means do not leave it open while sleeping. 开过 is experience, and 开在 needs a place after it.

items.q: 门口没放___鞋，说明他不在家。
items.zh: 门口没放着鞋，说明他不在家。
items.py: mén kǒu méi fàng zhe xié shuō míng tā bù zài jiā
items.en: There are no shoes left by the door, which shows he is not home.
items.why: Denying a 着 state uses 没: 没放着鞋 means no shoes are sitting there. 没放了 mixes the negator with 了, and 没放在 would need a place after it.

items.s: 刚才教室的门不锁着，我直接进去了。
items.s_py: gāng cái jiào shì de mén bù suǒ zhe wǒ zhí jiē jìn qù le
items.zh: 刚才教室的门没锁着，我直接进去了。
items.py: gāng cái jiào shì de mén méi suǒ zhe wǒ zhí jiē jìn qù le
items.en: The classroom door was not locked just now, so I went straight in.
items.why: A 着 state is denied with 没, not 不. 刚才 makes it a plain past denial, and 不锁着 is not a form Chinese uses here.

items.s: 窗户没开着，是我的朋友刚才关上的。
items.s_py: chuāng hù méi kāi zhe shì wǒ de péng yǒu gāng cái guān shàng de
items.zh: 窗户没开着，是我的朋友刚才关上的。
items.py: chuāng hù méi kāi zhe shì wǒ de péng yǒu gāng cái guān shàng de
items.en: The window is not open; my friend closed it just now.
items.why: Correct. 没开着 denies the state, and 关上的 adds that it was closed. The negator for a 着 state is 没.

items.s: 别站着聊了，我们找个地方坐下来吧。
items.s_py: bié zhàn zhe liáo le wǒ men zhǎo gè dì fāng zuò xià lái ba
items.zh: 别站着聊了，我们找个地方坐下来吧。
items.py: bié zhàn zhe liáo le wǒ men zhǎo gè dì fāng zuò xià lái ba
items.en: Let's stop standing around chatting and find somewhere to sit.
items.why: Correct. 别站着聊了 tells people to stop talking in the standing posture. 着 stays on the posture verb 站.

items.src_py: tā tǎng zhe kàn shū
items.task: Tell him not to, with 别.
items.zh: 别躺着看书。
items.py: bié tǎng zhe kàn shū
items.en: Don't read lying down.
items.why: 别 goes before the posture verb with 着 kept, forbidding that way of doing the main action.

items.src_py: chuāng hù kāi zhe
items.task: Deny it with 没: the window is not open.
items.zh: 窗户没开着。
items.py: chuāng hù méi kāi zhe
items.en: The window is not open.
items.why: A 着 state is denied with 没, never 不.

items.q: 朋友们喝___茶聊天。
items.zh: 朋友们喝着茶聊天。
items.py: péng yǒu men hē zhe chá liáo tiān
items.en: My friends chat over tea.
items.why: 着 goes right after the verb 喝 and before its object 茶. 喝在茶 and 喝过茶 do not mean drinking while chatting.

items.q: 他唱___歌走进了教室。
items.zh: 他唱着歌走进了教室。
items.py: tā chàng zhe gē zǒu jìn le jiào shì
items.en: He walked into the classroom singing.
items.why: 着 attaches to 唱, before the object 歌, and 走进 is the main verb. 唱在歌 is not a phrase, and 唱过歌 is experience.

items.q: 他躺___床上看雨，一动也不想动。
items.zh: 他躺在床上看雨，一动也不想动。
items.py: tā tǎng zài chuáng shàng kàn yǔ yī dòng yě bù xiǎng dòng
items.en: He lies on the bed watching the rain and doesn't want to move at all.
items.why: 躺在床上 is verb + 在 + place with no 着. 躺着床上 puts 着 before a place, which is wrong, and 躺上床上 repeats the place word.

items.q: 奶奶坐___椅子上晒太阳，一坐就是一下午。
items.zh: 奶奶坐在椅子上晒太阳，一坐就是一下午。
items.py: nǎi nai zuò zài yǐ zi shàng shài tài yáng yī zuò jiù shì yī xià wǔ
items.en: Grandma sits on a chair in the sun and stays there the whole afternoon.
items.why: 坐在椅子上 is verb + 在 + place, with no 着. 坐着椅子上 is wrong, and 坐过 is experience.

items.s: 我们喝茶着聊天。
items.s_py: wǒ men hē chá zhe liáo tiān
items.zh: 我们喝着茶聊天。
items.py: wǒ men hē zhe chá liáo tiān
items.en: We chat over tea.
items.why: 着 attaches to the verb 喝 and goes before the object 茶. 喝茶着 puts it after the object.

items.s: 他躺在沙发上看书，一整个下午都没动。
items.s_py: tā tǎng zài shā fā shàng kàn shū yī zhěng gè xià wǔ dōu méi dòng
items.zh: 他躺在沙发上看书，一整个下午都没动。
items.py: tā tǎng zài shā fā shàng kàn shū yī zhěng gè xià wǔ dōu méi dòng
items.en: He lay on the sofa reading and did not move all afternoon.
items.why: Correct. With 躺在 + place the verb takes no 着. Adding 着 would be wrong, which makes this look like a trap.

items.s: 他蹲着在门口等朋友。
items.s_py: tā dūn zhe zài mén kǒu děng péng yǒu
items.zh: 他蹲在门口等朋友。
items.py: tā dūn zài mén kǒu děng péng yǒu
items.en: He squats at the door waiting for a friend.
items.why: Verb + 在 + place takes no 着. 蹲着在 puts 着 in front of the 在 phrase, which Chinese never does.

items.zh: 她坐在窗边看雨。
items.py: tā zuò zài chuāng biān kàn yǔ
items.en: She sits by the window watching the rain.
items.why: 坐在 + place has no 着, and the main verb 看雨 follows the place.

items.zh: 我们在咖啡馆里坐着聊天。
items.py: wǒ men zài kā fēi guǎn lǐ zuò zhe liáo tiān
items.en: We sit in the cafe chatting.
items.why: The place phrase goes before 坐着, and 着 stays on the verb. 坐着在咖啡馆里 is wrong. The place may also open the sentence.

items.src_py: tā zài shā fā shàng tǎng zhe
items.task: Say it with 躺在 (no 着).
items.zh: 他躺在沙发上。
items.py: tā tǎng zài shā fā shàng
items.en: He is lying on the sofa.
items.why: 躺在 + place needs no 着. The place moves behind the verb.

items.q: 我知道___他的名字，可是不知道他的电话。
items.zh: 我知道他的名字，可是不知道他的电话。
items.py: wǒ zhī dào tā de míng zi kě shì bù zhī dào tā de diàn huà
items.en: I know his name, but I do not know his phone number.
items.why: 知道 is a state of knowing with nothing to hold, so it never takes 着, even though English "know" feels ongoing.

items.q: 朋友昨天到___上海，今天已经去玩了。
items.zh: 朋友昨天到了上海，今天已经去玩了。
items.py: péng yǒu zuó tiān dào le shàng hǎi jīn tiān yǐ jīng qù wán le
items.en: My friend arrived in Shanghai yesterday and has already gone out today.
items.why: 到 is an instant change that finished yesterday, so 到了. 着 cannot attach to an instant verb, and 过 would mean has been there at some time.

items.q: 我们在车站等___两个小时，朋友才到。
items.zh: 我们在车站等了两个小时，朋友才到。
items.py: wǒ men zài chē zhàn děng le liǎng gè xiǎo shí péng yǒu cái dào
items.en: We waited at the station for two hours before our friend arrived.
items.why: A duration follows the verb, and 着 cannot be measured, so 等了两个小时. 过 would mean we once waited, which does not fit 才到.

items.q: 我看见___朋友站在门口，就走过去了。
items.zh: 我看见朋友站在门口，就走过去了。
items.py: wǒ kàn jiàn péng yǒu zhàn zài mén kǒu jiù zǒu guò qù le
items.en: I saw my friend standing at the door and went over.
items.why: 看见 already has a result complement (见), so it never takes 着. 站在门口 is verb + 在 + place and has no 着 either.

items.q: 雨下___一晚上，早上才停。
items.zh: 雨下了一晚上，早上才停。
items.py: yǔ xià le yī wǎn shàng zǎo shàng cái tíng
items.en: It rained all night and only stopped in the morning.
items.why: A duration (一晚上) follows the verb, so 了 not 着. 在 cannot follow 下 here.

items.q: 他去年大学毕业___，现在在一家公司工作。
items.zh: 他去年大学毕业了，现在在一家公司工作。
items.py: tā qù nián dà xué bì yè le xiàn zài zài yī jiā gōng sī gōng zuò
items.en: He graduated from university last year and now works in a company.
items.why: 毕业 is an instant change, so it takes 了 for completion. 着 cannot attach to it, and 过 would be an odd experience reading.

items.q: 天黑以前，我们终于走到___朋友住的村子。
items.zh: 天黑以前，我们终于走到了朋友住的村子。
items.py: tiān hēi yǐ qián wǒ men zhōng yú zǒu dào le péng yǒu zhù de cūn zi
items.en: Before dark we finally reached the village where my friend lives.
items.why: 走到 marks arrival with an instant end point, so 了. 着 cannot follow it, and 过 would contradict 终于.

items.q: 我觉得___今年夏天会比去年热，大家都要多喝水。
items.zh: 我觉得今年夏天会比去年热，大家都要多喝水。
items.py: wǒ jué de jīn nián xià tiān huì bǐ qù nián rè dà jiā dōu yào duō hē shuǐ
items.en: I think this summer will be hotter than last year, so everyone should drink more water.
items.why: 觉得 is a thinking verb with nothing to hold, so it never takes 着.

items.q: 冬天到___，大家都穿上了厚衣服。
items.zh: 冬天到了，大家都穿上了厚衣服。
items.py: dōng tiān dào le dà jiā dōu chuān shàng le hòu yī fú
items.en: Winter has come, and everyone has put on thick clothes.
items.why: 到 is an instant change, so it takes 了 and never 着. 过 would mean winter had come at some earlier time, which does not fit.

items.s: 他到着公园，朋友还没来。
items.s_py: tā dào zhe gōng yuán péng yǒu hái méi lái
items.zh: 他到了公园，朋友还没来。
items.py: tā dào le gōng yuán péng yǒu hái méi lái
items.en: He has arrived at the park; his friend has not come yet.
items.why: 到 is an instant verb and never takes 着. 了 reports the arrival.

items.s: 我们在雨里等了半个小时，朋友才来。
items.s_py: wǒ men zài yǔ lǐ děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí péng yǒu cái lái
items.zh: 我们在雨里等了半个小时，朋友才来。
items.py: wǒ men zài yǔ lǐ děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí péng yǒu cái lái
items.en: We waited in the rain for half an hour before our friend came.
items.why: Correct. A duration follows 等, so it takes 了. 等着半个小时 would be wrong.

items.s: 我昨天就听懂着他的话，所以不用翻译。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān jiù tīng dǒng zhe tā de huà suǒ yǐ bù yòng fān yì
items.zh: 我昨天就听懂了他的话，所以不用翻译。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān jiù tīng dǒng le tā de huà suǒ yǐ bù yòng fān yì
items.en: I already understood his words yesterday, so no translation was needed.
items.why: 听懂 already carries a result complement, so it never takes 着. The completed result takes 了.

items.zh: 我认识小王三年了。
items.py: wǒ rèn shí xiǎo wáng sān nián le
items.en: I have known Xiao Wang for three years.
items.why: 认识 is a state and never takes 着. The duration 三年 follows the object and 了 ends the sentence.

items.src: 他在门口站着，站了半个小时。
items.src_py: tā zài mén kǒu zhàn zhe zhàn le bàn gè xiǎo shí
items.task: Combine into one sentence: he stood at the door for half an hour.
items.zh: 他在门口站了半个小时。
items.py: tā zài mén kǒu zhàn le bàn gè xiǎo shí
items.en: He stood at the door for half an hour.
items.why: A duration follows the verb, so 了, not 着. 着 states a position but cannot be measured.
